100	## Connections
101	The page behaviour below comes from the condensations of the pages that use these tables. Those pages are not part of this topic.
102	
103	- **`webERP/SecurityTokens.php`** writes `securitytokens`.
104	  - Insert and update need a numeric, non-empty `TokenId` and a non-empty `TokenDescription`.
105	  - Insert warns "Token ID already used" if the id exists.
106	  - Delete is refused if the token is used in the scripts `pagesecurity` or in the security roles.
107	  - Links to edit and delete are disabled for the fixed tokens 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 11, 12, 15, 18, 19, 20.
108	  - If `AllowDemoMode` is true, the page prints a warning and exits.
109	  - There is no transaction handling.
110	- **`webERP/AccountSections.php`** writes `accountsection`.
111	  - It creates default sections 1 (Income) and 2 (Cost Of Sales) on first load.
112	  - `SectionID` must be numeric with no ".".
113	  - `SectionName` must be non-empty and free of illegal characters.
114	  - Insert is refused if the id already exists.
115	  - Delete is refused if `accountgroups.sectioninaccounts` references the section.
116	  - Sections 1 and 2 show "Restricted" instead of a delete link.
117	  - The page has no permission check.
118	- **`webERP/Departments.php`** writes `departments`.
119	  - The name must be non-empty and free of illegal characters, and must not duplicate an existing name (`LIKE` match).
120	  - Edit and delete address the row by the old description (`WHERE description LIKE OldDepartmentName`), not by `departmentid`.
121	  - Delete is refused if `stockrequest` rows exist for the department.
122	  - Create and edit run in a transaction: any query failure sets `InputError=1`, and the page rolls back.
123	- **`webERP/Employees.php`** writes `employees`.
124	  - `Surname` and `FirstName` must be non-empty.
125	  - The stock choice list comes from `stockmaster` joined to `stockcategory` where `stocktype='L'`.
126	  - The manager choice list comes from `employees`.
127	  - The user choice list comes from `www_users`.
128	  - Delete runs unless `CancelDelete` is set; the timesheets dependency check is commented out.
129	  - There is no duplicate check on `UserID` or email, and no cycle check on managers.
130	- **`webERP/WWW_Users.php`** writes `www_users`.
131	  - A new user also gets a `locationusers` row and `glaccountusers` rows for every `chartmaster` account, each with canview=1 and canupd=1.
132	  - Delete is refused if `audittrail` has entries for the user.
133	  - Otherwise delete removes rows in this order: `locationusers`, `glaccountusers`, `bankaccountusers`, `purchorderauth`, `sessions`, `session_data`, `www_users`.
134	- **`webERP/Logout.php`** writes `session_data`. It deletes the user's row where `field='module'` and inserts `(userid, 'module', $_SESSION['Module'])`. It then deletes the `sessions` row for the current session id.
135	- **`webERP/index.php`** reads `session_data`: `SELECT value FROM session_data WHERE userid=...`, to restore the module when no module is stored in the session.
136	- **`webERP/sql/updates/6.php`** is the upgrade path. It creates `session_data` with the same shape as the install file. It adds `www_users.timeout` as TINYINT NOT NULL default 5 after `pagesize`. It calls `UpdateDBNo('6', ...)` only if `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors'] == 0`, and it has no error handling around its steps.
137	
138	## Conclusions
139	- In `session_data` the key is (userid, value), not (userid, field). One user can have several `field='module'` rows with different values, and the same value cannot be stored twice for a user. `Logout.php` deletes the user's `field='module'` row before inserting a new one, so only one module row normally exists. `index.php` reads `value` by `userid` and the condensation does not show it filtering on `field`.
140	- `session_data` has no foreign key to `www_users` and no expiry column. `WWW_Users.php` is what removes a user's rows, and it does so at user deletion.
141	- `departments.authoriser` has no foreign key and no index. Nothing in the schema stops a department from naming a user who does not exist. `Departments.php` identifies rows by description (`LIKE`), so a name containing `%` or `_` can match other departments.
142	- `departments` has no unique index on `description`. Only the page enforces uniqueness, so any other writer bypasses it.
143	- `reportlinks` has no primary key, so duplicate rows are possible.
144	- `accountsection` has no foreign key from `accountgroups.sectioninaccounts`; the delete refusal exists only in `AccountSections.php`.
145	- Deleting a security token is guarded only in `SecurityTokens.php`, because `securitytokens` has no referential constraints.
146	- The `www_users.timeout` default is 5 in both the install file and `6.php`, so a fresh install and an upgraded database match on that column.
147	- Changing a column here does not change the update scripts. Each update script (such as `sql/updates/6.php`) keeps its own copy of the definition, so a fresh install and an upgraded database can differ.
148	
149	## Hazards
150	- Rows saved in `session_data` with the same `value` for different fields collide on the primary key.
151	- `Employees.php` can create manager loops and duplicate user links.
152	- Account sections and departments can be left dangling by writers that do not use the pages.
153	- `emailsettings` stores `password` in a varchar(100) column. The condensations do not show whether it is hashed or encrypted.
154	- `debtorsmaster.ediserverpwd` is stored in a varchar(20) column, and `www_users.password` in a text column. The condensations do not show how either is protected.
155	- `departments`, `securitytokens` and `accountsection` pages have no permission checks.
156	- `6.php` can mark the update as applied (`UpdateDBNo`) only when `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors'] == 0`; its steps have no error handling or rollback.

# webERP: install schema, base tables (`source/webERP/install/sql/tables/*`)

Part of [webERP installer, seed data, schema, build/CI and project-history area](weberp-installer-seed-data-schema-build-ci-and-project-histo-150/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

These are CREATE TABLE definitions for the base tables of a fresh webERP install. They run no code and take nothing in. The PHP pages that read and write these tables, and the update scripts that migrate older databases, use them.

## Contract
Nothing is received or sent. All 22 files are `CREATE TABLE` definitions, each with `ENGINE=InnoDB` and `CHARSET=utf8mb4`. The tables are listed below.

| Table | Columns and keys |
|---|---|
| `accountsection` | `sectionid` int PK default 0; `sectionname` text |
| `areas` | `areacode` char(3) PK; `areadescription` varchar(25) default '' |
| `bankaccounts` | `accountcode` varchar(20) PK default '0', FK to `chartmaster(accountcode)`; `currcode` char(3) indexed; `invoice` smallint default 0; `bankaccountcode` varchar(50); `bankaccountname` char(50) indexed; `bankaccountnumber` char(50) indexed; `bankaddress` char(50); `importformat` varchar(10) |
| `chartmaster` | `accountcode` varchar(20) PK default '0'; `accountname` char(50) indexed; `group_` char(30) indexed, FK `chartmaster_ibfk_1` to `accountgroups(groupname)`; `cashflowsactivity` tinyint(1) default -1 |
| `config` | `confname` varchar(35) PK; `confvalue` text |
| `custcontacts` | `contid` auto-increment PK; `debtorno` varchar(10); `contactname` varchar(40); `role` varchar(40); `phoneno` varchar(20); `notes` varchar(255); `email` varchar(55); `statement` tinyint default 0 |
| `custnotes` | `noteid` auto-increment PK; `debtorno` varchar(10) default '0'; `href` varchar(100); `note` text; `date` date default '1000-01-01'; `priority` varchar(20) |
| `debtorsmaster` | see below |
| `departments` | `departmentid` auto-increment PK; `description` varchar(100); `authoriser` varchar(20) |
| `edimessageformat` | `id` auto-increment PK; `partnercode` varchar(10); `messagetype` varchar(6); `section` varchar(7); `sequenceno` int; `linetext` varchar(70); unique key `PartnerCode` (partnercode, messagetype, sequenceno); index `Section` |
| `emailsettings` | `id` auto-increment PK; `host` varchar(30); `port` char(5); `heloaddress` varchar(20); `username` varchar(50) null; `password` varchar(100) null; `timeout` int default 5; `companyname` varchar(50) null; `auth` tinyint(1) default 0 |
| `employees` | `id` auto-increment PK; `surname` varchar(20); `firstname` varchar(30); `stockid` varchar(20), FK to `stockmaster`; `manager` int null; `normalhours` double default 40; `userid` varchar(20); `email` varchar(55) default ''. Indexes: surname, firstname, stockid, manager, userid |
| `favourites` | `userid` varchar(20) default ''; `caption` varchar(50) default ''; `href` varchar(200) default '#'; PK (userid, caption) |
| `reportlinks` | `table1` varchar(25); `table2` varchar(25); `equation` varchar(75); no PK |
| `salescattranslations` | `salescatid` tinyint default 0; `language_id` varchar(10) default 'en_GB.utf8'; `salescattranslation` varchar(40); PK (salescatid, language_id) |
| `salescommissiontypes` | `commissiontypeid` tinyint auto-increment PK; `commissiontypename` varchar(55) default '' |
| `securitytokens` | `tokenid` int PK default 0; `tokenname` text |
| `session_data` | `userid` varchar(20); `field` varchar(100) default ''; `value` varchar(100) default ''; PK (userid, value) |
| `sessions` | `sessionid` char(32) PK; `logintime` timestamp default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP; `userid` varchar(20); `script` varchar(100) default ''; `scripttime` timestamp null |
| `www_users` | see below |

**`debtorsmaster`** (`debtorno` varchar(10) is the PK):
- `name` is varchar(40) and `address1` to `address6` are varchar(40, 40, 40, 50, 20, 40).

None. No code, no checks. The only guards are the column constraints in the table above.

## Decisions
These come from the schema, not from code:
- `chartmaster.group_` must exist in `accountgroups.groupname`, or the insert is refused.
- `bankaccounts.accountcode` must exist in `chartmaster.accountcode`.
- A `debtorsmaster` row needs a valid currency, sales type, hold reason, payment terms and debtor type.
- `www_users.defaultlocation` must exist in `locations.loccode`.
- `employees.stockid` must exist in `stockmaster`.
- `edimessageformat` rejects a second row with the same (partnercode, messagetype, sequenceno).
- `favourites` allows only one row per (userid, caption).
- `session_data` allows only one row per (userid, value), because `value` is in the key and `field` is not.
- `salescattranslations` allows one row per (salescatid, language_id).

## Order and failure
Not applicable. No code runs here.

## Connections
The page behaviour below comes from the condensations of the pages that use these tables. Those pages are not part of this topic.

- **`webERP/SecurityTokens.php`** writes `securitytokens`.
  - Insert and update need a numeric, non-empty `TokenId` and a non-empty `TokenDescription`.
  - Insert warns "Token ID already used" if the id exists.
  - Delete is refused if the token is used in the scripts `pagesecurity` or in the security roles.
  - Links to edit and delete are disabled for the fixed tokens 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 11, 12, 15, 18, 19, 20.
  - If `AllowDemoMode` is true, the page prints a warning and exits.
  - There is no transaction handling.
- **`webERP/AccountSections.php`** writes `accountsection`.
  - It creates default sections 1 (Income) and 2 (Cost Of Sales) on first load.
  - `SectionID` must be numeric with no ".".
  - `SectionName` must be non-empty and free of illegal characters.
  - Insert is refused if the id already exists.
  - Delete is refused if `accountgroups.sectioninaccounts` references the section.
  - Sections 1 and 2 show "Restricted" instead of a delete link.
  - The page has no permission check.
- **`webERP/Departments.php`** writes `departments`.
  - The name must be non-empty and free of illegal characters, and must not duplicate an existing name (`LIKE` match).
  - Edit and delete address the row by the old description (`WHERE description LIKE OldDepartmentName`), not by `departmentid`.
  - Delete is refused if `stockrequest` rows exist for the department.
  - Create and edit run in a transaction: any query failure sets `InputError=1`, and the page rolls back.
- **`webERP/Employees.php`** writes `employees`.
  - `Surname` and `FirstName` must be non-empty.
  - The stock choice list comes from `stockmaster` joined to `stockcategory` where `stocktype='L'`.
  - The manager choice list comes from `employees`.
  - The user choice list comes from `www_users`.
  - Delete runs unless `CancelDelete` is set; the timesheets dependency check is commented out.
  - There is no duplicate check on `UserID` or email, and no cycle check on managers.
- **`webERP/WWW_Users.php`** writes `www_users`.
  - A new user also gets a `locationusers` row and `glaccountusers` rows for every `chartmaster` account, each with canview=1 and canupd=1.
  - Delete is refused if `audittrail` has entries for the user.
  - Otherwise delete removes rows in this order: `locationusers`, `glaccountusers`, `bankaccountusers`, `purchorderauth`, `sessions`, `session_data`, `www_users`.
- **`webERP/Logout.php`** writes `session_data`. It deletes the user's row where `field='module'` and inserts `(userid, 'module', $_SESSION['Module'])`. It then deletes the `sessions` row for the current session id.
- **`webERP/index.php`** reads `session_data`: `SELECT value FROM session_data WHERE userid=...`, to restore the module when no module is stored in the session.
- **`webERP/sql/updates/6.php`** is the upgrade path. It creates `session_data` with the same shape as the install file. It adds `www_users.timeout` as TINYINT NOT NULL default 5 after `pagesize`. It calls `UpdateDBNo('6', ...)` only if `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors'] == 0`, and it has no error handling around its steps.

## Conclusions
- In `session_data` the key is (userid, value), not (userid, field). One user can have several `field='module'` rows with different values, and the same value cannot be stored twice for a user. `Logout.php` deletes the user's `field='module'` row before inserting a new one, so only one module row normally exists. `index.php` reads `value` by `userid` and the condensation does not show it filtering on `field`.
- `session_data` has no foreign key to `www_users` and no expiry column. `WWW_Users.php` is what removes a user's rows, and it does so at user deletion.
- `departments.authoriser` has no foreign key and no index. Nothing in the schema stops a department from naming a user who does not exist. `Departments.php` identifies rows by description (`LIKE`), so a name containing `%` or `_` can match other departments.
- `departments` has no unique index on `description`. Only the page enforces uniqueness, so any other writer bypasses it.
- `reportlinks` has no primary key, so duplicate rows are possible.
- `accountsection` has no foreign key from `accountgroups.sectioninaccounts`; the delete refusal exists only in `AccountSections.php`.
- Deleting a security token is guarded only in `SecurityTokens.php`, because `securitytokens` has no referential constraints.
- The `www_users.timeout` default is 5 in both the install file and `6.php`, so a fresh install and an upgraded database match on that column.
- Changing a column here does not change the update scripts. Each update script (such as `sql/updates/6.php`) keeps its own copy of the definition, so a fresh install and an upgraded database can differ.

## Hazards
- Rows saved in `session_data` with the same `value` for different fields collide on the primary key.
- `Employees.php` can create manager loops and duplicate user links.
- Account sections and departments can be left dangling by writers that do not use the pages.
- `emailsettings` stores `password` in a varchar(100) column. The condensations do not show whether it is hashed or encrypted.
- `debtorsmaster.ediserverpwd` is stored in a varchar(20) column, and `www_users.password` in a text column. The condensations do not show how either is protected.
- `departments`, `securitytokens` and `accountsection` pages have no permission checks.
- `6.php` can mark the update as applied (`UpdateDBNo`) only when `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors'] == 0`; its steps have no error handling or rollback.

<?php

/* Shared helpers for the credit control pages (CreditControl*.php) and for the order entry routes that have to
 respect a customer's credit status.

 A customer's credit status is NOT a new field. It is the existing debtorsmaster.holdreason, whose
 holdreasons.dissallowinvoices value says what the reason means:
	1 = the account is on stop (no orders, no dispatch, no invoicing)
	2 = the account is on watch (supplied, but everyone dealing with it is warned)
	anything else = normal
 Every route that takes or releases an order asks this file, so there is one rule for all of them. */

/* The pages and functions below look at the page security tokens through the scripts registered for them, in the
 same way SelectOrderItems.php looks at ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php */
function CreditControlUser() {
	return isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControl.php'])
		AND in_array($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControl.php'], $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

function CreditControlApprover() {
	return isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlApprovals.php'])
		AND in_array($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlApprovals.php'], $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* config values are loaded into $_SESSION by GetConfig.php. A database that has not yet run update 44 has none of them, so there is always a default */
function CreditControlParam($Name, $Default) {
	return isset($_SESSION[$Name]) ? $_SESSION[$Name] : $Default;
}

/* The GL accounts credit control posts to are kept in the companies table (not config) so that Z_ChangeGLAccountCode.php renames them with all the others */
function CreditControlAccounts() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT latechargeinterestact,
								latechargefeeact,
								baddebtact
						FROM companies
						WHERE coycode = 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
		return DB_fetch_array($Result);
	}
	return array('latechargeinterestact' => '0', 'latechargefeeact' => '0', 'baddebtact' => '0');
}

					'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
					'" . $PeriodNo . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Reference) . "',
					'" . $Branch['salestype'] . "',
					'" . $Rate . "',
					'" . $AmountFX . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
					0,
					1,
					'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "')";

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,

<?php

/* Shared helpers for the credit control pages (CreditControl*.php) and for the order entry routes that have to
 respect a customer's credit status.

 A customer's credit status is NOT a new field. It is the existing debtorsmaster.holdreason, whose
 holdreasons.dissallowinvoices value says what the reason means:
	1 = the account is on stop (no orders, no dispatch, no invoicing)
	2 = the account is on watch (supplied, but everyone dealing with it is warned)
	anything else = normal
 Every route that takes or releases an order asks this file, so there is one rule for all of them. */

/* The pages and functions below look at the page security tokens through the scripts registered for them, in the
 same way SelectOrderItems.php looks at ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php */
function CreditControlUser() {
	return isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControl.php'])
		AND in_array($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControl.php'], $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

function CreditControlApprover() {
	return isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlApprovals.php'])
		AND in_array($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlApprovals.php'], $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* config values are loaded into $_SESSION by GetConfig.php. A database that has not yet run update 44 has none of them, so there is always a default */
function CreditControlParam($Name, $Default) {
	return isset($_SESSION[$Name]) ? $_SESSION[$Name] : $Default;
}

/* The GL accounts credit control posts to are kept in the companies table (not config) so that Z_ChangeGLAccountCode.php renames them with all the others */
function CreditControlAccounts() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT latechargeinterestact,
								latechargefeeact,
								baddebtact
						FROM companies
						WHERE coycode = 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
		return DB_fetch_array($Result);
	}
	return array('latechargeinterestact' => '0', 'latechargefeeact' => '0', 'baddebtact' => '0');
}

/* Returns the credit status of a customer, or false if there is no such customer.
 status is one of 'normal', 'watch' or 'stop' */
function GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
					debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					debtorsmaster.nextcreditreview,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
			FROM debtorsmaster
			INNER JOIN holdreasons
				ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
			WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The credit status of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'stop';
	} elseif ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 2) {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'watch';
	} else {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'normal';
	}
	return $MyRow;
}

function CreditStatusText($Status) {
	switch ($Status) {
		case 'stop':
			return __('On stop');
		case 'watch':
			return __('On watch');
		default:
			return __('Normal');
	}
}

/* A short coloured status for the pages where staff look at a customer. $ShowReason is false for the customer portal */
function CreditStatusBanner($DebtorNo, $ShowReason = true) {
	$Status = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Status === false OR $Status['status'] == 'normal') {
		return '';
	}
	$Reason = ($ShowReason AND $Status['reasondescription'] != '') ? ' - ' . htmlspecialchars($Status['reasondescription'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') : '';
	if ($Status['status'] == 'stop') {
		return prnMsg(__('Credit status') . ': ' . CreditStatusText('stop') . $Reason . '. ' . __('No orders can be taken or goods dispatched. Please contact credit control.'), 'error', '', true);
	}
	return prnMsg(__('Credit status') . ': ' . CreditStatusText('watch') . $Reason . '. ' . __('This customer can still be supplied, but please contact credit control to discuss before taking an order.'), 'warn', '', true);
}

/* reasons a credit controller can choose for a status change. $Kind is 'stop', 'watch' or 'normal' */
function CreditReasonOptions($Kind, $Selected = '') {
	switch ($Kind) {
		case 'stop':
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices = 1';
			break;
		case 'watch':
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices = 2';
			break;
		default:
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices NOT IN (1, 2)';
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode, reasondescription FROM holdreasons WHERE " . $Where . " ORDER BY reasoncode");
	$Options = '';
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Options .= '<option ' . ($Selected == $MyRow['reasoncode'] ? 'selected="selected" ' : '') . 'value="' . $MyRow['reasoncode'] . '">' . htmlspecialchars($MyRow['reasondescription'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '</option>';
	}
	return $Options;
}

/* the hold reason a new customer starts with: the lowest reason code that is neither stop nor watch */
function CreditDefaultReason() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices NOT IN (1, 2) ORDER BY reasoncode LIMIT 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return 0;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

/* the date of the next credit review for a customer whose account is opened (or loaded) today */
function CreditNextReviewDate() {
	$Months = (int) CreditControlParam('CreditReviewMonths', 12);
	if ($Months < 1) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . $Months . ' months'));
}

/* Would an order of this value (in the customer's currency) take the customer over their credit limit?
 Uses the existing CheckCreditLimits setting (0 = off), and the setting that turns holding on or off. */
function CreditControlOverLimit($DebtorNo, $OrderValue) {
	if (CreditControlParam('CheckCreditLimits', 0) == 0 OR CreditControlParam('CreditHoldOverLimitOrders', 1) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	if (!function_exists('GetCreditAvailable')) {
		include_once(__DIR__ . '/SQL_CommonFunctions.php');
	}
	return (GetCreditAvailable($DebtorNo) - $OrderValue) < 0;
}

/* One line in the history credit control keeps per customer. The auditors read this. */
function CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, $Action, $Detail, $Amount = 0, $Currency = '') {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditlog (debtorno,
									logdate,
									userid,
									action,
									detail,
									amount,
									currcode)
			VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
					NOW(),
					'" . $_SESSION['UserID'] . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Action) . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Detail) . "',
					'" . $Amount . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Currency) . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history entry could not be saved because'));
}

/* The customer's overdue debit documents (invoices, and the interest and fee charges), oldest first.
 The due date follows the customer's payment terms in the same way AgedDebtors.php ages them. */
function CreditOverdueDocuments($DebtorNo) {
	$DueDate = "IF(paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0,
					DATE_ADD(debtortrans.trandate, INTERVAL paymentterms.daysbeforedue DAY),
					DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), INTERVAL paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth DAY))";
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					debtortrans.balance,
					debtortrans.disputed,
					debtortrans.rate,
					" . $DueDate . " AS duedate,
					DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . $DueDate . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
			AND debtortrans.type IN (10, 15)
			AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
			HAVING daysoverdue > 0
			ORDER BY duedate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue transactions of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	$Documents = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Documents[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Documents;
}

/* overdue is what is chased and charged: undisputed and net of credits that are on the account but not allocated.
 disputed invoices are listed separately and are neither chased nor charged until the dispute is settled (BR-18) */
function CreditOverdueSummary($DebtorNo) {
	$Summary = array('documents' => CreditOverdueDocuments($DebtorNo),
					'overdue' => 0,
					'disputed' => 0,
					'maxdays' => 0,
					'credits' => 0,
					'net' => 0);
	foreach ($Summary['documents'] as $Document) {
		if ($Document['disputed'] == 1) {
			$Summary['disputed'] += $Document['balance'];
		} else {
			$Summary['overdue'] += $Document['balance'];
			if ($Document['daysoverdue'] > $Summary['maxdays']) {
				$Summary['maxdays'] = $Document['daysoverdue'];
			}
		}
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) AS credits
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
						AND balance < -0.005");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Summary['credits'] = -$MyRow['credits'];
	$Summary['net'] = max(0, $Summary['overdue'] - $Summary['credits']);
	return $Summary;
}

/* Allocate an amount of a credit document (a waiver or a write-off) to a debit document, the way CustomerAllocations.php does:
 a custallocns row, and alloc and settled on both transactions. The credit's alloc has the same sign as its amount. */
function CreditControlAllocate($FromID, $ToID, $Amount, $DateSQL) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (amt,
										datealloc,
										transid_allocfrom,
										transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . $Amount . "',
						'" . $DateSQL . "',
						'" . $FromID . "',
						'" . $ToID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be saved because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . $Amount . " WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'",
			__('The allocation could not be applied to the debit because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . $Amount . " WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'",
			__('The allocation could not be applied to the credit because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'");
}

/* Post a customer journal (debtortrans type 15 'Journal - Debtors') with its general ledger entries. Used for interest and fee
 charges (positive), and for waivers and write-offs (negative). The caller owns the transaction (DB_Txn_Begin / DB_Txn_Commit).
 $AmountFX is in the customer's currency; $Rate is the customer's currency rate to the home currency; $GLLines are the
 gltrans entries in home currency. Returns the new debtortrans id, number and period. */
function CreditControlPostDebtorJournal($DebtorNo, $AmountFX, $Rate, $TransDateSQL, $Reference, $Narrative, $GLLines) {
	$BranchResult = DB_query("SELECT custbranch.branchcode,
									custbranch.salesman,
									debtorsmaster.salestype
							FROM custbranch
							INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
								ON custbranch.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
							WHERE custbranch.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode
							LIMIT 1",
							__('The branch of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	$Branch = DB_fetch_array($BranchResult);

	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(ConvertSQLDate($TransDateSQL));
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo(15);

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									shipvia,
									edisent,
									salesperson)
			VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
					15,
					'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
					'" . $Branch['branchcode'] . "',
					'" . $TransDateSQL . "',
					'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
					'" . $PeriodNo . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Reference) . "',
					'" . $Branch['salestype'] . "',
					'" . $Rate . "',
					'" . $AmountFX . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
					0,
					1,
					'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The customer journal could not be posted because'), '', true);
	$TransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		foreach ($GLLines as $GLLine) {
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount)
					VALUES (15,
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $TransDateSQL . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $GLLine['account'] . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
							'" . $GLLine['amount'] . "')";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The general ledger entry for the customer journal could not be posted because'), '', true);
		}
	}
	return array('id' => $TransID, 'transno' => $TransNo, 'period' => $PeriodNo);
}

<?php

// Credit control: reviews, stop and watch, reminder letters, interest and late fees, bad debt write-offs.
// Every change here is also made in install/sql/tables and install/sql/data/creditcontrol.sql for new installations.

// 1. Customer master: review date and the exemptions from interest and fees.
// A customer's credit status is not a new column, it is the existing debtorsmaster.holdreason (holdreasons.dissallowinvoices: 1 stop, 2 watch)
AddColumn('nextcreditreview', 'debtorsmaster', 'date', 'NOT NULL', '1000-01-01', 'language_id');
AddColumn('interestexempt', 'debtorsmaster', 'tinyint(1)', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'nextcreditreview');
AddColumn('feeexempt', 'debtorsmaster', 'tinyint(1)', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'interestexempt');

// Every existing customer starts with a next review date one standard review period from today (a date still at 1000-01-01 means never reviewed)
executeSQL("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET nextcreditreview = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) WHERE nextcreditreview = '1000-01-01'");

// 2. An invoice can be marked as disputed so it is not chased or charged interest
AddColumn('disputed', 'debtortrans', 'tinyint(1)', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'balance');

// 3. Orders over the credit limit are held until credit control releases them
AddColumn('creditheld', 'salesorders', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'internalcomment');

// 4. The GL accounts that credit control posts to
AddColumn('latechargeinterestact', 'companies', 'varchar(20)', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'freightact');
AddColumn('latechargefeeact', 'companies', 'varchar(20)', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'latechargeinterestact');
AddColumn('baddebtact', 'companies', 'varchar(20)', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'latechargefeeact');

// 5. Tables. None of them has a foreign key to debtorsmaster so the history outlives the customer record.
CreateTable('creditreviews', "CREATE TABLE `creditreviews` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `reviewdate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `outcome` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `oldlimit` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `newlimit` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `nextreview` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `reviewdate` (`reviewdate`)
)");

CreateTable('creditlog', "CREATE TABLE `creditlog` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `logdate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `action` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `detail` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `logdate` (`logdate`),
  KEY `action` (`action`)
)");

CreateTable('dunningstages', "CREATE TABLE `dunningstages` (
  `stage` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `daysoverdue` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `subject` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `body` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`stage`)
)");

CreateTable('dunningletters', "CREATE TABLE `dunningletters` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `stage` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `sentdate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `method` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'email',
  `sentto` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `invoices` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `sentdate` (`sentdate`)
)");

CreateTable('latecharges', "CREATE TABLE `latecharges` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `chargemonth` char(7) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `chargetype` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'I' COMMENT 'I interest, F late fee',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `rate` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `basebalance` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `debtortransid` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `transno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `chargedate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `waived` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `waivedtransno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `waivedreason` varchar(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `onechargepermonth` (`debtorno`,`chargemonth`,`chargetype`),
  KEY `debtortransid` (`debtortransid`)
)");

CreateTable('writeoffs', "CREATE TABLE `writeoffs` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `homeamount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `reason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `requestedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `requesteddate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT 'pending, rejected or posted',
  `approvedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `approveddate` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `approvalnote` varchar(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `stopcustomer` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `debtortransid` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `transno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `status` (`status`)
)");

// 6. Settings. Finance sets the real values on CreditControlParameters.php; the rate and the fee start at 0 so nothing is charged until they do.
NewConfigValue('CreditReviewMonths', '12');
NewConfigValue('CreditHoldOverLimitOrders', '1');
NewConfigValue('CreditInterestRate', '0');
NewConfigValue('CreditLateFee', '0');
NewConfigValue('CreditChargeDays', '14');
NewConfigValue('CreditChargeOnCharges', '0');
NewConfigValue('CreditDunningMinDays', '14');
NewConfigValue('CreditDunningResetDays', '90');
NewConfigValue('CreditStopAfterFinal', '0');
NewConfigValue('CreditWriteOffApprovalLimit', '1000');
NewConfigValue('CreditWriteOffAutoStop', '1');

// 7. Credit statuses a credit controller can choose from. Existing hold reasons are left alone.
InsertRecord('holdreasons', array('reasoncode'), array(100), array('reasoncode', 'reasondescription', 'dissallowinvoices'), array(100, 'Account in good standing', 0));
InsertRecord('holdreasons', array('reasoncode'), array(101), array('reasoncode', 'reasondescription', 'dissallowinvoices'), array(101, 'Credit watch', 2));
InsertRecord('holdreasons', array('reasoncode'), array(102), array('reasoncode', 'reasondescription', 'dissallowinvoices'), array(102, 'Credit stop', 1));

// 8. The three standard reminder stages
InsertRecord('dunningstages', array('stage'), array(1), array('stage', 'daysoverdue', 'subject', 'body'), array(1, 30, 'Reminder: overdue invoices on your account', "Dear {customer},\n\nOur records show that the invoices below are overdue for payment. If you have already paid them, please disregard this letter, otherwise please arrange payment as soon as possible.\n\n{invoices}\nTotal overdue: {currency} {amount}\n\nKind regards\n{company}"));
InsertRecord('dunningstages', array('stage'), array(2), array('stage', 'daysoverdue', 'subject', 'body'), array(2, 45, 'Second reminder: overdue invoices on your account', "Dear {customer},\n\nWe wrote to you recently about the overdue invoices below and have not yet received payment. Please pay them now, or contact us today if there is a problem.\n\n{invoices}\nTotal overdue: {currency} {amount}\n\nKind regards\n{company}"));
InsertRecord('dunningstages', array('stage'), array(3), array('stage', 'daysoverdue', 'subject', 'body'), array(3, 60, 'FINAL NOTICE: overdue invoices on your account', "Dear {customer},\n\nThis is our final notice. The invoices below remain unpaid. Unless we receive payment in full within 7 days your account will be put on stop, no further orders will be accepted and late payment charges will be applied.\n\n{invoices}\nTotal overdue: {currency} {amount}\n\nKind regards\n{company}"));

// 9. Security. Token 21 is credit control, token 22 is the finance director's approval of large write-offs.
// Sales reps and the sales office do not get either, which is what stops them changing a status or a limit.
// Roles that should have them are chosen on the user and role pages (WWW_Access.php); the Accountant and System Administrator roles get token 21 and the System Administrator role token 22 to start with.
NewSecurityToken(21, 'Credit control - reviews, stop and watch, reminders, charges and write-offs');
NewSecurityToken(22, 'Credit control approval - write-offs above the approval limit');
InsertRecord('securitygroups', array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(6, 21), array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(6, 21));
InsertRecord('securitygroups', array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(8, 21), array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(8, 21));
InsertRecord('securitygroups', array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(8, 22), array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(8, 22));

NewScript('CreditControl.php', 21);
NewScript('CreditControlReport.php', 21);
NewScript('CreditControlDunning.php', 21);
NewScript('CreditControlCharges.php', 21);
NewScript('CreditControlWriteOffs.php', 21);
NewScript('CreditControlApprovals.php', 22);
NewScript('CreditControlParameters.php', 21);
NewScript('CustomerCreditHistory.php', 1);

// 10. Menu
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Credit Control'), '/CreditControl.php', 5);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Reports', __('Credit Control Report'), '/CreditControlReport.php', 11);

// 11. Debtors journals (type 15) carry the interest, fees, waivers and write-offs
NewSysType(15, 'Journal - Debtors');

if ($_SESSION['Updates']['Errors'] == 0) {
	UpdateDBNo(basename(__FILE__, '.php'), __('Credit control: credit reviews, stop and watch, reminders, late charges and write-offs'));
}

// Every change here is also made in install/sql/tables and install/sql/data/creditcontrol.sql for new installations.

// 1. Customer master: review date and the exemptions from interest and fees.
// A customer's credit status is not a new column, it is the existing debtorsmaster.holdreason (holdreasons.dissallowinvoices: 1 stop, 2 watch)
AddColumn('nextcreditreview', 'debtorsmaster', 'date', 'NOT NULL', '1000-01-01', 'language_id');
AddColumn('interestexempt', 'debtorsmaster', 'tinyint(1)', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'nextcreditreview');
AddColumn('feeexempt', 'debtorsmaster', 'tinyint(1)', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'interestexempt');

// Every existing customer starts with a next review date one standard review period from today (a date still at 1000-01-01 means never reviewed)
executeSQL("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET nextcreditreview = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) WHERE nextcreditreview = '1000-01-01'");

// 2. An invoice can be marked as disputed so it is not chased or charged interest
AddColumn('disputed', 'debtortrans', 'tinyint(1)', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'balance');

// 3. Orders over the credit limit are held until credit control releases them
AddColumn('creditheld', 'salesorders', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'internalcomment');

// 4. The GL accounts that credit control posts to
AddColumn('latechargeinterestact', 'companies', 'varchar(20)', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'freightact');
AddColumn('latechargefeeact', 'companies', 'varchar(20)', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'latechargeinterestact');
AddColumn('baddebtact', 'companies', 'varchar(20)', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'latechargefeeact');

// 5. Tables. None of them has a foreign key to debtorsmaster so the history outlives the customer record.
CreateTable('creditreviews', "CREATE TABLE `creditreviews` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `reviewdate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `outcome` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `oldlimit` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `newlimit` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `nextreview` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `reviewdate` (`reviewdate`)
)");

CreateTable('creditlog', "CREATE TABLE `creditlog` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `logdate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `action` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `detail` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `logdate` (`logdate`),
  KEY `action` (`action`)
)");

CreateTable('dunningstages', "CREATE TABLE `dunningstages` (
  `stage` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `daysoverdue` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `subject` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `body` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`stage`)
)");

CreateTable('dunningletters', "CREATE TABLE `dunningletters` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `stage` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `sentdate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `method` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'email',
  `sentto` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `invoices` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `sentdate` (`sentdate`)
)");

CreateTable('latecharges', "CREATE TABLE `latecharges` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `chargemonth` char(7) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `chargetype` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'I' COMMENT 'I interest, F late fee',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `rate` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `basebalance` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `debtortransid` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `transno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `chargedate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `waived` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `waivedtransno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `waivedreason` varchar(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `onechargepermonth` (`debtorno`,`chargemonth`,`chargetype`),
  KEY `debtortransid` (`debtortransid`)
)");

CreateTable('writeoffs', "CREATE TABLE `writeoffs` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `homeamount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `reason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `requestedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `requesteddate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT 'pending, rejected or posted',
  `approvedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `approveddate` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `approvalnote` varchar(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `stopcustomer` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `debtortransid` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `transno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),

<?php

/* Shared helpers for the credit control pages (CreditControl*.php) and for the order entry routes that have to
 respect a customer's credit status.

 A customer's credit status is NOT a new field. It is the existing debtorsmaster.holdreason, whose
 holdreasons.dissallowinvoices value says what the reason means:
	1 = the account is on stop (no orders, no dispatch, no invoicing)
	2 = the account is on watch (supplied, but everyone dealing with it is warned)
	anything else = normal
 Every route that takes or releases an order asks this file, so there is one rule for all of them. */

/* The pages and functions below look at the page security tokens through the scripts registered for them, in the
 same way SelectOrderItems.php looks at ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php */
function CreditControlUser() {
	return isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControl.php'])
		AND in_array($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControl.php'], $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

function CreditControlApprover() {
	return isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlApprovals.php'])
		AND in_array($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlApprovals.php'], $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* config values are loaded into $_SESSION by GetConfig.php. A database that has not yet run update 44 has none of them, so there is always a default */
function CreditControlParam($Name, $Default) {
	return isset($_SESSION[$Name]) ? $_SESSION[$Name] : $Default;
}

/* The GL accounts credit control posts to are kept in the companies table (not config) so that Z_ChangeGLAccountCode.php renames them with all the others */
function CreditControlAccounts() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT latechargeinterestact,
								latechargefeeact,
								baddebtact
						FROM companies
						WHERE coycode = 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
		return DB_fetch_array($Result);
	}
	return array('latechargeinterestact' => '0', 'latechargefeeact' => '0', 'baddebtact' => '0');
}

/* Returns the credit status of a customer, or false if there is no such customer.
 status is one of 'normal', 'watch' or 'stop' */
function GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
					debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					debtorsmaster.nextcreditreview,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
			FROM debtorsmaster
			INNER JOIN holdreasons
				ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
			WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The credit status of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'stop';
	} elseif ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 2) {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'watch';
	} else {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'normal';
	}
	return $MyRow;
}

function CreditStatusText($Status) {
	switch ($Status) {
		case 'stop':
			return __('On stop');
		case 'watch':
			return __('On watch');
		default:
			return __('Normal');
	}
}

/* A short coloured status for the pages where staff look at a customer. $ShowReason is false for the customer portal */
function CreditStatusBanner($DebtorNo, $ShowReason = true) {
	$Status = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Status === false OR $Status['status'] == 'normal') {
		return '';
	}
	$Reason = ($ShowReason AND $Status['reasondescription'] != '') ? ' - ' . htmlspecialchars($Status['reasondescription'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') : '';
	if ($Status['status'] == 'stop') {
		return prnMsg(__('Credit status') . ': ' . CreditStatusText('stop') . $Reason . '. ' . __('No orders can be taken or goods dispatched. Please contact credit control.'), 'error', '', true);
	}
	return prnMsg(__('Credit status') . ': ' . CreditStatusText('watch') . $Reason . '. ' . __('This customer can still be supplied, but please contact credit control to discuss before taking an order.'), 'warn', '', true);
}

/* reasons a credit controller can choose for a status change. $Kind is 'stop', 'watch' or 'normal' */
function CreditReasonOptions($Kind, $Selected = '') {
	switch ($Kind) {
		case 'stop':
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices = 1';
			break;
		case 'watch':
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices = 2';
			break;
		default:
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices NOT IN (1, 2)';
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode, reasondescription FROM holdreasons WHERE " . $Where . " ORDER BY reasoncode");
	$Options = '';
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Options .= '<option ' . ($Selected == $MyRow['reasoncode'] ? 'selected="selected" ' : '') . 'value="' . $MyRow['reasoncode'] . '">' . htmlspecialchars($MyRow['reasondescription'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '</option>';
	}
	return $Options;
}

/* the hold reason a new customer starts with: the lowest reason code that is neither stop nor watch */
function CreditDefaultReason() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices NOT IN (1, 2) ORDER BY reasoncode LIMIT 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return 0;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

/* the date of the next credit review for a customer whose account is opened (or loaded) today */
function CreditNextReviewDate() {
	$Months = (int) CreditControlParam('CreditReviewMonths', 12);
	if ($Months < 1) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . $Months . ' months'));
}

/* Would an order of this value (in the customer's currency) take the customer over their credit limit?
 Uses the existing CheckCreditLimits setting (0 = off), and the setting that turns holding on or off. */
function CreditControlOverLimit($DebtorNo, $OrderValue) {
	if (CreditControlParam('CheckCreditLimits', 0) == 0 OR CreditControlParam('CreditHoldOverLimitOrders', 1) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	if (!function_exists('GetCreditAvailable')) {
		include_once(__DIR__ . '/SQL_CommonFunctions.php');
	}
	return (GetCreditAvailable($DebtorNo) - $OrderValue) < 0;
}

/* One line in the history credit control keeps per customer. The auditors read this. */
function CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, $Action, $Detail, $Amount = 0, $Currency = '') {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditlog (debtorno,
									logdate,
									userid,
									action,
									detail,
									amount,
									currcode)
			VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
					NOW(),
					'" . $_SESSION['UserID'] . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Action) . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Detail) . "',
					'" . $Amount . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Currency) . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history entry could not be saved because'));
}

/* The customer's overdue debit documents (invoices, and the interest and fee charges), oldest first.
 The due date follows the customer's payment terms in the same way AgedDebtors.php ages them. */
function CreditOverdueDocuments($DebtorNo) {
	$DueDate = "IF(paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0,
					DATE_ADD(debtortrans.trandate, INTERVAL paymentterms.daysbeforedue DAY),
					DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), INTERVAL paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth DAY))";
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					debtortrans.balance,
					debtortrans.disputed,
					debtortrans.rate,
					" . $DueDate . " AS duedate,
					DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . $DueDate . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
			AND debtortrans.type IN (10, 15)
			AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
			HAVING daysoverdue > 0
			ORDER BY duedate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue transactions of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	$Documents = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Documents[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Documents;
}

/* overdue is what is chased and charged: undisputed and net of credits that are on the account but not allocated.
 disputed invoices are listed separately and are neither chased nor charged until the dispute is settled (BR-18) */
function CreditOverdueSummary($DebtorNo) {
	$Summary = array('documents' => CreditOverdueDocuments($DebtorNo),
					'overdue' => 0,
					'disputed' => 0,
					'maxdays' => 0,
					'credits' => 0,
					'net' => 0);
	foreach ($Summary['documents'] as $Document) {
		if ($Document['disputed'] == 1) {
			$Summary['disputed'] += $Document['balance'];
		} else {
			$Summary['overdue'] += $Document['balance'];
			if ($Document['daysoverdue'] > $Summary['maxdays']) {
				$Summary['maxdays'] = $Document['daysoverdue'];
			}
		}
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) AS credits
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
						AND balance < -0.005");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Summary['credits'] = -$MyRow['credits'];
	$Summary['net'] = max(0, $Summary['overdue'] - $Summary['credits']);
	return $Summary;
}

/* Allocate an amount of a credit document (a waiver or a write-off) to a debit document, the way CustomerAllocations.php does:
 a custallocns row, and alloc and settled on both transactions. The credit's alloc has the same sign as its amount. */
function CreditControlAllocate($FromID, $ToID, $Amount, $DateSQL) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (amt,
										datealloc,
										transid_allocfrom,
										transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . $Amount . "',
						'" . $DateSQL . "',
						'" . $FromID . "',
						'" . $ToID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be saved because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . $Amount . " WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'",
			__('The allocation could not be applied to the debit because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . $Amount . " WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'",
			__('The allocation could not be applied to the credit because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'");
}

/* Post a customer journal (debtortrans type 15 'Journal - Debtors') with its general ledger entries. Used for interest and fee
 charges (positive), and for waivers and write-offs (negative). The caller owns the transaction (DB_Txn_Begin / DB_Txn_Commit).
 $AmountFX is in the customer's currency; $Rate is the customer's currency rate to the home currency; $GLLines are the
 gltrans entries in home currency. Returns the new debtortrans id, number and period. */
function CreditControlPostDebtorJournal($DebtorNo, $AmountFX, $Rate, $TransDateSQL, $Reference, $Narrative, $GLLines) {
	$BranchResult = DB_query("SELECT custbranch.branchcode,
									custbranch.salesman,
									debtorsmaster.salestype
							FROM custbranch
							INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
								ON custbranch.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
							WHERE custbranch.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode
							LIMIT 1",
							__('The branch of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	$Branch = DB_fetch_array($BranchResult);

	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(ConvertSQLDate($TransDateSQL));
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo(15);

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									shipvia,
									edisent,
									salesperson)
			VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
					15,
					'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
					'" . $Branch['branchcode'] . "',
					'" . $TransDateSQL . "',
					'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
					'" . $PeriodNo . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Reference) . "',
					'" . $Branch['salestype'] . "',
					'" . $Rate . "',
					'" . $AmountFX . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
					0,
					1,
					'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The customer journal could not be posted because'), '', true);
	$TransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		foreach ($GLLines as $GLLine) {
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount)
					VALUES (15,
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $TransDateSQL . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $GLLine['account'] . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
							'" . $GLLine['amount'] . "')";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The general ledger entry for the customer journal could not be posted because'), '', true);
		}
	}
	return array('id' => $TransID, 'transno' => $TransNo, 'period' => $PeriodNo);
}

	return true;

<?php

/* Shared helpers for the credit control pages (CreditControl*.php) and for the order entry routes that have to
 respect a customer's credit status.

	1 = the account is on stop (no orders, no dispatch, no invoicing)
	2 = the account is on watch (supplied, but everyone dealing with it is warned)
	anything else = normal
 Every route that takes or releases an order asks this file, so there is one rule for all of them. */

/* The pages and functions below look at the page security tokens through the scripts registered for them, in the
 same way SelectOrderItems.php looks at ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php */
function CreditControlUser() {
	return isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControl.php'])
		AND in_array($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControl.php'], $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

function CreditControlApprover() {
	return isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlApprovals.php'])
		AND in_array($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlApprovals.php'], $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* config values are loaded into $_SESSION by GetConfig.php. A database that has not yet run update 44 has none of them, so there is always a default */
function CreditControlParam($Name, $Default) {
	return isset($_SESSION[$Name]) ? $_SESSION[$Name] : $Default;
}

/* The GL accounts credit control posts to are kept in the companies table (not config) so that Z_ChangeGLAccountCode.php renames them with all the others */
function CreditControlAccounts() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT latechargeinterestact,
								latechargefeeact,
								baddebtact
						FROM companies
						WHERE coycode = 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
		return DB_fetch_array($Result);
	}
	return array('latechargeinterestact' => '0', 'latechargefeeact' => '0', 'baddebtact' => '0');
}

/* Returns the credit status of a customer, or false if there is no such customer.
 status is one of 'normal', 'watch' or 'stop' */
function GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
					debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					debtorsmaster.nextcreditreview,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
			FROM debtorsmaster
			INNER JOIN holdreasons
				ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
			WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The credit status of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'stop';
	} elseif ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 2) {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'watch';
	} else {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'normal';
	}
	return $MyRow;
}

function CreditStatusText($Status) {
	switch ($Status) {
		case 'stop':
			return __('On stop');
		case 'watch':
			return __('On watch');
		default:
			return __('Normal');
	}
}

/* A short coloured status for the pages where staff look at a customer. $ShowReason is false for the customer portal */
function CreditStatusBanner($DebtorNo, $ShowReason = true) {
	$Status = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Status === false OR $Status['status'] == 'normal') {
		return '';
	}
	$Reason = ($ShowReason AND $Status['reasondescription'] != '') ? ' - ' . htmlspecialchars($Status['reasondescription'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') : '';
	if ($Status['status'] == 'stop') {
		return prnMsg(__('Credit status') . ': ' . CreditStatusText('stop') . $Reason . '. ' . __('No orders can be taken or goods dispatched. Please contact credit control.'), 'error', '', true);
	}
	return prnMsg(__('Credit status') . ': ' . CreditStatusText('watch') . $Reason . '. ' . __('This customer can still be supplied, but please contact credit control to discuss before taking an order.'), 'warn', '', true);
}

/* reasons a credit controller can choose for a status change. $Kind is 'stop', 'watch' or 'normal' */
function CreditReasonOptions($Kind, $Selected = '') {
	switch ($Kind) {
		case 'stop':
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices = 1';
			break;
		case 'watch':
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices = 2';
			break;
		default:
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices NOT IN (1, 2)';
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode, reasondescription FROM holdreasons WHERE " . $Where . " ORDER BY reasoncode");
	$Options = '';
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Options .= '<option ' . ($Selected == $MyRow['reasoncode'] ? 'selected="selected" ' : '') . 'value="' . $MyRow['reasoncode'] . '">' . htmlspecialchars($MyRow['reasondescription'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '</option>';
	}
	return $Options;
}

/* the hold reason a new customer starts with: the lowest reason code that is neither stop nor watch */
function CreditDefaultReason() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices NOT IN (1, 2) ORDER BY reasoncode LIMIT 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return 0;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

/* the date of the next credit review for a customer whose account is opened (or loaded) today */
function CreditNextReviewDate() {
	$Months = (int) CreditControlParam('CreditReviewMonths', 12);
	if ($Months < 1) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . $Months . ' months'));
}

/* Would an order of this value (in the customer's currency) take the customer over their credit limit?
 Uses the existing CheckCreditLimits setting (0 = off), and the setting that turns holding on or off. */
function CreditControlOverLimit($DebtorNo, $OrderValue) {
	if (CreditControlParam('CheckCreditLimits', 0) == 0 OR CreditControlParam('CreditHoldOverLimitOrders', 1) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	if (!function_exists('GetCreditAvailable')) {
		include_once(__DIR__ . '/SQL_CommonFunctions.php');
	}
	return (GetCreditAvailable($DebtorNo) - $OrderValue) < 0;
}

 has to be escaped by the caller with DB_escape_string before it is passed in. */
function CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, $Action, $Detail, $Amount = 0, $Currency = '') {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditlog (debtorno,
									logdate,
									userid,
									action,
									detail,
									amount,
									currcode)
			VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
					NOW(),
					'" . $_SESSION['UserID'] . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Action) . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Detail) . "',
					'" . $Amount . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Currency) . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history entry could not be saved because'));
}

/* The customer's overdue debit documents (invoices, and the interest and fee charges), oldest first.
 The due date follows the customer's payment terms in the same way AgedDebtors.php ages them. */
function CreditOverdueDocuments($DebtorNo) {
	$DueDate = "IF(paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0,
					DATE_ADD(debtortrans.trandate, INTERVAL paymentterms.daysbeforedue DAY),
					DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), INTERVAL paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth DAY))";
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					debtortrans.balance,
					debtortrans.disputed,
					debtortrans.rate,
					" . $DueDate . " AS duedate,
					DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . $DueDate . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
			AND debtortrans.type IN (10, 15)
			AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
			HAVING daysoverdue > 0
			ORDER BY duedate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue transactions of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	$Documents = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Documents[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Documents;
}

/* overdue is what is chased and charged: undisputed and net of credits that are on the account but not allocated.
 disputed invoices are listed separately and are neither chased nor charged until the dispute is settled (BR-18) */
function CreditOverdueSummary($DebtorNo) {
	$Summary = array('documents' => CreditOverdueDocuments($DebtorNo),
					'overdue' => 0,
					'disputed' => 0,
					'maxdays' => 0,
					'credits' => 0,
					'net' => 0);
	foreach ($Summary['documents'] as $Document) {
		if ($Document['disputed'] == 1) {
			$Summary['disputed'] += $Document['balance'];
		} else {
			$Summary['overdue'] += $Document['balance'];
			if ($Document['daysoverdue'] > $Summary['maxdays']) {
				$Summary['maxdays'] = $Document['daysoverdue'];
			}
		}
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) AS credits
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
						AND balance < -0.005");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Summary['credits'] = -$MyRow['credits'];
	$Summary['net'] = max(0, $Summary['overdue'] - $Summary['credits']);
	return $Summary;
}

/* Allocate an amount of a credit document (a waiver or a write-off) to a debit document, the way CustomerAllocations.php does:
 a custallocns row, and alloc and settled on both transactions. The credit's alloc has the same sign as its amount. */
function CreditControlAllocate($FromID, $ToID, $Amount, $DateSQL) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (amt,
										datealloc,
										transid_allocfrom,
										transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . $Amount . "',
						'" . $DateSQL . "',
						'" . $FromID . "',
						'" . $ToID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be saved because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . $Amount . " WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'",
			__('The allocation could not be applied to the debit because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . $Amount . " WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'",
			__('The allocation could not be applied to the credit because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'");
}

	DB_query($SQL, __('The customer journal could not be posted because'), '', true);
	$TransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		foreach ($GLLines as $GLLine) {
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,

				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator

			ORDER BY duedate, debtortrans.id";

function CreditOverdueSummary($DebtorNo) {

					'disputed' => 0,

					'credits' => 0,
					'net' => 0);

		if ($Document['disputed'] == 1) {
			$Summary['disputed'] += $Document['balance'];
		} else {
			$Summary['overdue'] += $Document['balance'];
			if ($Document['daysoverdue'] > $Summary['maxdays']) {
				$Summary['maxdays'] = $Document['daysoverdue'];
			}
		}
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) AS credits
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
						AND balance < -0.005");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
