		AND in_array($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlApprovals.php'], $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* config values are loaded into $_SESSION by GetConfig.php. A database that has not yet run update 44 has none of them, so there is always a default */
function CreditControlParam($Name, $Default) {
	return isset($_SESSION[$Name]) ? $_SESSION[$Name] : $Default;
}

/* The GL accounts credit control posts to are kept in the companies table (not config) so that Z_ChangeGLAccountCode.php renames them with all the others */
function CreditControlAccounts() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT latechargeinterestact,
								latechargefeeact,
								baddebtact
						FROM companies
						WHERE coycode = 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
		return DB_fetch_array($Result);
	}
	return array('latechargeinterestact' => '0', 'latechargefeeact' => '0', 'baddebtact' => '0');
}

/* Returns the credit status of a customer, or false if there is no such customer.
 status is one of 'normal', 'watch' or 'stop' */
function GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
					debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					debtorsmaster.nextcreditreview,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
			FROM debtorsmaster
			INNER JOIN holdreasons
				ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
			WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The credit status of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'stop';
	} elseif ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 2) {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'watch';
	} else {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'normal';
	}
	return $MyRow;
}

function CreditStatusText($Status) {
	switch ($Status) {
		case 'stop':
			return __('On stop');
		case 'watch':
			return __('On watch');
		default:
			return __('Normal');
	}
}

/* A short coloured status for the pages where staff look at a customer. $ShowReason is false for the customer portal */
function CreditStatusBanner($DebtorNo, $ShowReason = true) {
	$Status = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Status === false OR $Status['status'] == 'normal') {
		return '';
	}
	$Reason = ($ShowReason AND $Status['reasondescription'] != '') ? ' - ' . htmlspecialchars($Status['reasondescription'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') : '';
	if ($Status['status'] == 'stop') {
		return prnMsg(__('Credit status') . ': ' . CreditStatusText('stop') . $Reason . '. ' . __('No orders can be taken or goods dispatched. Please contact credit control.'), 'error', '', true);
	}
	return prnMsg(__('Credit status') . ': ' . CreditStatusText('watch') . $Reason . '. ' . __('This customer can still be supplied, but please contact credit control to discuss before taking an order.'), 'warn', '', true);
}

/* reasons a credit controller can choose for a status change. $Kind is 'stop', 'watch' or 'normal' */
function CreditReasonOptions($Kind, $Selected = '') {
	switch ($Kind) {
		case 'stop':
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices = 1';
			break;
		case 'watch':
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices = 2';
			break;
		default:
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices NOT IN (1, 2)';
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode, reasondescription FROM holdreasons WHERE " . $Where . " ORDER BY reasoncode");
	$Options = '';
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Options .= '<option ' . ($Selected == $MyRow['reasoncode'] ? 'selected="selected" ' : '') . 'value="' . $MyRow['reasoncode'] . '">' . htmlspecialchars($MyRow['reasondescription'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '</option>';
	}
	return $Options;
}

/* the hold reason a new customer starts with: the lowest reason code that is neither stop nor watch */
function CreditDefaultReason() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices NOT IN (1, 2) ORDER BY reasoncode LIMIT 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return 0;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

/* the date of the next credit review for a customer whose account is opened (or loaded) today */
function CreditNextReviewDate() {
	$Months = (int) CreditControlParam('CreditReviewMonths', 12);
	if ($Months < 1) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . $Months . ' months'));
}

/* Would an order of this value (in the customer's currency) take the customer over their credit limit?
 Uses the existing CheckCreditLimits setting (0 = off), and the setting that turns holding on or off. */
function CreditControlOverLimit($DebtorNo, $OrderValue) {
	if (CreditControlParam('CheckCreditLimits', 0) == 0 OR CreditControlParam('CreditHoldOverLimitOrders', 1) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	if (!function_exists('GetCreditAvailable')) {
		include_once(__DIR__ . '/SQL_CommonFunctions.php');
	}
	return (GetCreditAvailable($DebtorNo) - $OrderValue) < 0;
}

/* One line in the history credit control keeps per customer. The auditors read this.
 As elsewhere in webERP, values that came from $_POST or $_GET were escaped by session.php already; text built from the database
 has to be escaped by the caller with DB_escape_string before it is passed in. */
function CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, $Action, $Detail, $Amount = 0, $Currency = '') {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditlog (debtorno,
									logdate,
									userid,
									action,
									detail,
									amount,
									currcode)
			VALUES ('" . $DebtorNo . "',
					NOW(),
					'" . $_SESSION['UserID'] . "',
					'" . $Action . "',
					'" . $Detail . "',
					'" . $Amount . "',
					'" . $Currency . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history entry could not be saved because'));
}

/* The customer's overdue debit documents (invoices, and the interest and fee charges), oldest first.
 The due date follows the customer's payment terms in the same way AgedDebtors.php ages them. */
function CreditOverdueDocuments($DebtorNo) {
	$DueDate = "IF(paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0,
					DATE_ADD(debtortrans.trandate, INTERVAL paymentterms.daysbeforedue DAY),
					DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), INTERVAL paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth DAY))";
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					debtortrans.balance,
					debtortrans.disputed,
					debtortrans.rate,
					" . $DueDate . " AS duedate,
					DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . $DueDate . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
			AND debtortrans.type IN (10, 15)
			AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
			HAVING daysoverdue > 0
			ORDER BY duedate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue transactions of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	$Documents = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Documents[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Documents;
}

/* overdue is what is chased and charged: undisputed and net of credits that are on the account but not allocated.
 disputed invoices are listed separately and are neither chased nor charged until the dispute is settled (BR-18) */
function CreditOverdueSummary($DebtorNo) {
	$Summary = array('documents' => CreditOverdueDocuments($DebtorNo),
					'overdue' => 0,
					'disputed' => 0,
					'maxdays' => 0,
					'credits' => 0,
					'net' => 0);
	foreach ($Summary['documents'] as $Document) {
		if ($Document['disputed'] == 1) {
			$Summary['disputed'] += $Document['balance'];
		} else {
			$Summary['overdue'] += $Document['balance'];
			if ($Document['daysoverdue'] > $Summary['maxdays']) {
				$Summary['maxdays'] = $Document['daysoverdue'];
			}
		}
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) AS credits
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
						AND balance < -0.005");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Summary['credits'] = -$MyRow['credits'];
	$Summary['net'] = max(0, $Summary['overdue'] - $Summary['credits']);
	return $Summary;
}

/* Allocate an amount of a credit document (a waiver or a write-off) to a debit document, the way CustomerAllocations.php does:
 a custallocns row, and alloc and settled on both transactions. The credit's alloc has the same sign as its amount. */
function CreditControlAllocate($FromID, $ToID, $Amount, $DateSQL) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (amt,
										datealloc,
										transid_allocfrom,
										transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . $Amount . "',
						'" . $DateSQL . "',
						'" . $FromID . "',
						'" . $ToID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be saved because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . $Amount . " WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'",
			__('The allocation could not be applied to the debit because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . $Amount . " WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'",
			__('The allocation could not be applied to the credit because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'");
}

/* Post a customer journal (debtortrans type 15 'Journal - Debtors') with its general ledger entries. Used for interest and fee
 charges (positive), and for waivers and write-offs (negative). The caller owns the transaction (DB_Txn_Begin / DB_Txn_Commit).
 $AmountFX is in the customer's currency; $Rate is the customer's currency rate to the home currency; $GLLines are the
 gltrans entries in home currency. Returns the new debtortrans id, number and period. */
function CreditControlPostDebtorJournal($DebtorNo, $AmountFX, $Rate, $TransDateSQL, $Reference, $Narrative, $GLLines) {
	$BranchResult = DB_query("SELECT custbranch.branchcode,
									custbranch.salesman,
									debtorsmaster.salestype
							FROM custbranch
							INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
								ON custbranch.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
							WHERE custbranch.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
							ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode
							LIMIT 1",
							__('The branch of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	$Branch = DB_fetch_array($BranchResult);

	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(ConvertSQLDate($TransDateSQL));
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo(15);

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									shipvia,
									edisent,
									salesperson)
			VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
					15,
					'" . $DebtorNo . "',
					'" . $Branch['branchcode'] . "',
					'" . $TransDateSQL . "',
					'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
					'" . $PeriodNo . "',
					'" . $Reference . "',
					'" . $Branch['salestype'] . "',
					'" . $Rate . "',
					'" . $AmountFX . "',
					'" . $Narrative . "',
					0,
					1,
					'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The customer journal could not be posted because'), '', true);
	$TransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		foreach ($GLLines as $GLLine) {
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount)
					VALUES (15,
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $TransDateSQL . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $GLLine['account'] . "',
							'" . mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 200) . "',
							'" . $GLLine['amount'] . "')";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The general ledger entry for the customer journal could not be posted because'), '', true);
		}
	}
	return array('id' => $TransID, 'transno' => $TransNo, 'period' => $PeriodNo);
}

/* Put a customer on stop or on watch, or back to normal, by pointing it at a hold reason of that kind. The change and who made it
 go into the credit history. Returns false if the reason code does not exist. */
function CreditControlSetStatus($DebtorNo, $ReasonCode, $Note) {
	$Old = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	$ReasonResult = DB_query("SELECT reasondescription, dissallowinvoices FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode = '" . (int) $ReasonCode . "'");
	if ($Old === false OR DB_num_rows($ReasonResult) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Reason = DB_fetch_array($ReasonResult);
	if ($Reason['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		$NewStatus = 'stop';
	} elseif ($Reason['dissallowinvoices'] == 2) {
		$NewStatus = 'watch';
	} else {
		$NewStatus = 'normal';
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason = '" . (int) $ReasonCode . "' WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status of the customer could not be changed because'));
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo,
					strtoupper($NewStatus),
					CreditStatusText($Old['status']) . ' (' . $Old['reasondescription'] . ') ' . __('to') . ' ' . CreditStatusText($NewStatus) . ' (' . $Reason['reasondescription'] . '): ' . $Note);
	return true;
}

<?php

/* Shared helpers for the credit control pages (CreditControl*.php) and for the order entry routes that have to
 respect a customer's credit status.

 A customer's credit status is NOT a new field. It is the existing debtorsmaster.holdreason, whose
 holdreasons.dissallowinvoices value says what the reason means:
	1 = the account is on stop (no orders, no dispatch, no invoicing)
	2 = the account is on watch (supplied, but everyone dealing with it is warned)
	anything else = normal
 Every route that takes or releases an order asks this file, so there is one rule for all of them. */

/* The pages and functions below look at the page security tokens through the scripts registered for them, in the
 same way SelectOrderItems.php looks at ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php */
function CreditControlUser() {
	return isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControl.php'])
		AND in_array($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControl.php'], $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

function CreditControlApprover() {
	return isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlApprovals.php'])
		AND in_array($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlApprovals.php'], $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* config values are loaded into $_SESSION by GetConfig.php. A database that has not yet run update 44 has none of them, so there is always a default */
function CreditControlParam($Name, $Default) {
	return isset($_SESSION[$Name]) ? $_SESSION[$Name] : $Default;
}

/* The GL accounts credit control posts to are kept in the companies table (not config) so that Z_ChangeGLAccountCode.php renames them with all the others */
function CreditControlAccounts() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT latechargeinterestact,
								latechargefeeact,
								baddebtact
						FROM companies
						WHERE coycode = 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
		return DB_fetch_array($Result);
	}
	return array('latechargeinterestact' => '0', 'latechargefeeact' => '0', 'baddebtact' => '0');
}

/* Returns the credit status of a customer, or false if there is no such customer.
 status is one of 'normal', 'watch' or 'stop' */
function GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
					debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					debtorsmaster.nextcreditreview,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
			FROM debtorsmaster
			INNER JOIN holdreasons
				ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
			WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The credit status of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'stop';
	} elseif ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 2) {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'watch';
	} else {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'normal';
	}
	return $MyRow;
}

function CreditStatusText($Status) {
	switch ($Status) {
		case 'stop':
			return __('On stop');
		case 'watch':
			return __('On watch');
		default:
			return __('Normal');
	}
}

/* A short coloured status for the pages where staff look at a customer. $ShowReason is false for the customer portal */
function CreditStatusBanner($DebtorNo, $ShowReason = true) {
	$Status = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Status === false OR $Status['status'] == 'normal') {
		return '';
	}
	$Reason = ($ShowReason AND $Status['reasondescription'] != '') ? ' - ' . htmlspecialchars($Status['reasondescription'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') : '';
	if ($Status['status'] == 'stop') {
		return prnMsg(__('Credit status') . ': ' . CreditStatusText('stop') . $Reason . '. ' . __('No orders can be taken or goods dispatched. Please contact credit control.'), 'error', '', true);
	}
	return prnMsg(__('Credit status') . ': ' . CreditStatusText('watch') . $Reason . '. ' . __('This customer can still be supplied, but please contact credit control to discuss before taking an order.'), 'warn', '', true);
}

/* reasons a credit controller can choose for a status change. $Kind is 'stop', 'watch' or 'normal' */
function CreditReasonOptions($Kind, $Selected = '') {
	switch ($Kind) {
		case 'stop':
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices = 1';
			break;
		case 'watch':
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices = 2';
			break;
		default:
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices NOT IN (1, 2)';
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode, reasondescription FROM holdreasons WHERE " . $Where . " ORDER BY reasoncode");
	$Options = '';
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Options .= '<option ' . ($Selected == $MyRow['reasoncode'] ? 'selected="selected" ' : '') . 'value="' . $MyRow['reasoncode'] . '">' . htmlspecialchars($MyRow['reasondescription'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '</option>';
	}
	return $Options;
}

/* the hold reason a new customer starts with: the lowest reason code that is neither stop nor watch */
function CreditDefaultReason() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices NOT IN (1, 2) ORDER BY reasoncode LIMIT 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return 0;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

/* the date of the next credit review for a customer whose account is opened (or loaded) today */
function CreditNextReviewDate() {
	$Months = (int) CreditControlParam('CreditReviewMonths', 12);
	if ($Months < 1) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . $Months . ' months'));
}

/* Would an order of this value (in the customer's currency) take the customer over their credit limit?
 Uses the existing CheckCreditLimits setting (0 = off), and the setting that turns holding on or off. */
function CreditControlOverLimit($DebtorNo, $OrderValue) {
	if (CreditControlParam('CheckCreditLimits', 0) == 0 OR CreditControlParam('CreditHoldOverLimitOrders', 1) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	if (!function_exists('GetCreditAvailable')) {
		include_once(__DIR__ . '/SQL_CommonFunctions.php');
	}
	return (GetCreditAvailable($DebtorNo) - $OrderValue) < 0;
}

/* One line in the history credit control keeps per customer. The auditors read this.
 As elsewhere in webERP, values that came from $_POST or $_GET were escaped by session.php already; text built from the database
 has to be escaped by the caller with DB_escape_string before it is passed in. */
function CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, $Action, $Detail, $Amount = 0, $Currency = '') {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditlog (debtorno,
									logdate,
									userid,
									action,
									detail,
									amount,
									currcode)
			VALUES ('" . $DebtorNo . "',
					NOW(),
					'" . $_SESSION['UserID'] . "',
					'" . $Action . "',
					'" . $Detail . "',
					'" . $Amount . "',
					'" . $Currency . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history entry could not be saved because'));
}

/* The customer's overdue debit documents (invoices, and the interest and fee charges), oldest first.
 The due date follows the customer's payment terms in the same way AgedDebtors.php ages them. */
function CreditOverdueDocuments($DebtorNo) {
	$DueDate = "IF(paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0,
					DATE_ADD(debtortrans.trandate, INTERVAL paymentterms.daysbeforedue DAY),
					DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), INTERVAL paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth DAY))";
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					debtortrans.balance,
					debtortrans.disputed,
					debtortrans.rate,
					" . $DueDate . " AS duedate,
					DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . $DueDate . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
			AND debtortrans.type IN (10, 15)
			AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
			HAVING daysoverdue > 0
			ORDER BY duedate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue transactions of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	$Documents = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Documents[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Documents;
}

/* overdue is what is chased and charged: undisputed and net of credits that are on the account but not allocated.
 disputed invoices are listed separately and are neither chased nor charged until the dispute is settled (BR-18) */
function CreditOverdueSummary($DebtorNo) {
	$Summary = array('documents' => CreditOverdueDocuments($DebtorNo),
					'overdue' => 0,
					'disputed' => 0,
					'maxdays' => 0,
					'credits' => 0,
					'net' => 0);
	foreach ($Summary['documents'] as $Document) {
		if ($Document['disputed'] == 1) {
			$Summary['disputed'] += $Document['balance'];
		} else {
			$Summary['overdue'] += $Document['balance'];
			if ($Document['daysoverdue'] > $Summary['maxdays']) {
				$Summary['maxdays'] = $Document['daysoverdue'];
			}
		}
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) AS credits
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
						AND balance < -0.005");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Summary['credits'] = -$MyRow['credits'];
	$Summary['net'] = max(0, $Summary['overdue'] - $Summary['credits']);
	return $Summary;
}

/* Allocate an amount of a credit document (a waiver or a write-off) to a debit document, the way CustomerAllocations.php does:
 a custallocns row, and alloc and settled on both transactions. The credit's alloc has the same sign as its amount. */
function CreditControlAllocate($FromID, $ToID, $Amount, $DateSQL) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (amt,
										datealloc,
										transid_allocfrom,
										transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . $Amount . "',
						'" . $DateSQL . "',
						'" . $FromID . "',
						'" . $ToID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be saved because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . $Amount . " WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'",
			__('The allocation could not be applied to the debit because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . $Amount . " WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'",
			__('The allocation could not be applied to the credit because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'");
}

/* Post a customer journal (debtortrans type 15 'Journal - Debtors') with its general ledger entries. Used for interest and fee
 charges (positive), and for waivers and write-offs (negative). The caller owns the transaction (DB_Txn_Begin / DB_Txn_Commit).
 $AmountFX is in the customer's currency; $Rate is the customer's currency rate to the home currency; $GLLines are the
 gltrans entries in home currency. Returns the new debtortrans id, number and period. */
function CreditControlPostDebtorJournal($DebtorNo, $AmountFX, $Rate, $TransDateSQL, $Reference, $Narrative, $GLLines) {
	$BranchResult = DB_query("SELECT custbranch.branchcode,
									custbranch.salesman,
									debtorsmaster.salestype
							FROM custbranch
							INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
								ON custbranch.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
							WHERE custbranch.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
							ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode
							LIMIT 1",
							__('The branch of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	$Branch = DB_fetch_array($BranchResult);

	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(ConvertSQLDate($TransDateSQL));
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo(15);

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									shipvia,
									edisent,
									salesperson)
			VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
					15,
					'" . $DebtorNo . "',
					'" . $Branch['branchcode'] . "',
					'" . $TransDateSQL . "',
					'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
					'" . $PeriodNo . "',
					'" . $Reference . "',
					'" . $Branch['salestype'] . "',
					'" . $Rate . "',
					'" . $AmountFX . "',
					'" . $Narrative . "',
					0,
					1,
					'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The customer journal could not be posted because'), '', true);
	$TransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		foreach ($GLLines as $GLLine) {
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount)
					VALUES (15,
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $TransDateSQL . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $GLLine['account'] . "',
							'" . mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 200) . "',
							'" . $GLLine['amount'] . "')";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The general ledger entry for the customer journal could not be posted because'), '', true);
		}
	}
	return array('id' => $TransID, 'transno' => $TransNo, 'period' => $PeriodNo);
}

/* Put a customer on stop or on watch, or back to normal, by pointing it at a hold reason of that kind. The change and who made it
 go into the credit history. Returns false if the reason code does not exist. */
function CreditControlSetStatus($DebtorNo, $ReasonCode, $Note) {
	$Old = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	$ReasonResult = DB_query("SELECT reasondescription, dissallowinvoices FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode = '" . (int) $ReasonCode . "'");
	if ($Old === false OR DB_num_rows($ReasonResult) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Reason = DB_fetch_array($ReasonResult);
	if ($Reason['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		$NewStatus = 'stop';
	} elseif ($Reason['dissallowinvoices'] == 2) {
		$NewStatus = 'watch';
	} else {
		$NewStatus = 'normal';
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason = '" . (int) $ReasonCode . "' WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status of the customer could not be changed because'));
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo,
					strtoupper($NewStatus),
					CreditStatusText($Old['status']) . ' (' . DB_escape_string($Old['reasondescription']) . ') ' . __('to') . ' ' . CreditStatusText($NewStatus) . ' (' . DB_escape_string($Reason['reasondescription']) . '): ' . $Note);
	return true;
}

/* The customer's overdue debit documents (invoices, and the interest and fee charges), oldest first.
 The due date follows the customer's payment terms in the same way AgedDebtors.php ages them. */
function CreditOverdueDocuments($DebtorNo) {
	$DueDate = "IF(paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0,
					DATE_ADD(debtortrans.trandate, INTERVAL paymentterms.daysbeforedue DAY),
					DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), INTERVAL paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth DAY))";
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					debtortrans.balance,
					debtortrans.disputed,
					debtortrans.rate,
					" . $DueDate . " AS duedate,
					DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . $DueDate . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
			AND debtortrans.type IN (10, 15)
			AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
			HAVING daysoverdue > 0
			ORDER BY duedate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue transactions of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	$Documents = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Documents[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Documents;
}

/* overdue is what is chased and charged: undisputed and net of credits that are on the account but not allocated.
 disputed invoices are listed separately and are neither chased nor charged until the dispute is settled (BR-18) */
function CreditOverdueSummary($DebtorNo) {
	$Summary = array('documents' => CreditOverdueDocuments($DebtorNo),
					'overdue' => 0,
					'disputed' => 0,
					'maxdays' => 0,
					'credits' => 0,
					'net' => 0);
	foreach ($Summary['documents'] as $Document) {
		if ($Document['disputed'] == 1) {
			$Summary['disputed'] += $Document['balance'];
		} else {
			$Summary['overdue'] += $Document['balance'];
			if ($Document['daysoverdue'] > $Summary['maxdays']) {
				$Summary['maxdays'] = $Document['daysoverdue'];
			}
		}
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) AS credits
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
						AND balance < -0.005");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Summary['credits'] = -$MyRow['credits'];
	$Summary['net'] = max(0, $Summary['overdue'] - $Summary['credits']);
	return $Summary;
}

/* Allocate an amount of a credit document (a waiver or a write-off) to a debit document, the way CustomerAllocations.php does:
 a custallocns row, and alloc and settled on both transactions. The credit's alloc has the same sign as its amount. */
function CreditControlAllocate($FromID, $ToID, $Amount, $DateSQL) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (amt,
										datealloc,
										transid_allocfrom,
										transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . $Amount . "',
						'" . $DateSQL . "',
						'" . $FromID . "',
						'" . $ToID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be saved because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . $Amount . " WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'",
			__('The allocation could not be applied to the debit because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . $Amount . " WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'",
			__('The allocation could not be applied to the credit because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'");
}

/* Post a customer journal (debtortrans type 15 'Journal - Debtors') with its general ledger entries. Used for interest and fee
 charges (positive), and for waivers and write-offs (negative). The caller owns the transaction (DB_Txn_Begin / DB_Txn_Commit).
 $AmountFX is in the customer's currency; $Rate is the customer's currency rate to the home currency; $GLLines are the
 gltrans entries in home currency. Returns the new debtortrans id, number and period. */
function CreditControlPostDebtorJournal($DebtorNo, $AmountFX, $Rate, $TransDateSQL, $Reference, $Narrative, $GLLines) {
	$BranchResult = DB_query("SELECT custbranch.branchcode,
									custbranch.salesman,
									debtorsmaster.salestype
							FROM custbranch
							INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
								ON custbranch.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
							WHERE custbranch.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
							ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode
							LIMIT 1",
							__('The branch of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	$Branch = DB_fetch_array($BranchResult);

	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(ConvertSQLDate($TransDateSQL));
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo(15);

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									shipvia,
									edisent,
									salesperson)
			VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
					15,
					'" . $DebtorNo . "',
					'" . $Branch['branchcode'] . "',
					'" . $TransDateSQL . "',
					'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
					'" . $PeriodNo . "',
					'" . $Reference . "',
					'" . $Branch['salestype'] . "',
					'" . $Rate . "',
					'" . $AmountFX . "',
					'" . $Narrative . "',
					0,
					1,
					'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The customer journal could not be posted because'), '', true);
	$TransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		foreach ($GLLines as $GLLine) {
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount)
					VALUES (15,
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $TransDateSQL . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $GLLine['account'] . "',
							'" . mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 200) . "',
							'" . $GLLine['amount'] . "')";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The general ledger entry for the customer journal could not be posted because'), '', true);
		}
	}
	return array('id' => $TransID, 'transno' => $TransNo, 'period' => $PeriodNo);
}

/* Post an approved (or small enough not to need approval) bad debt write-off request.
 The write-off is a customer journal (type 15) that credits the customer's account in the customer's currency and is allocated to the oldest open
 invoices and charges, the way a receipt would be. Each invoice is cleared at its own exchange rate, so the debtors control account is credited with
 exactly what those invoices put in it, and the whole carrying value, exchange difference included, goes to the bad debt account.
 Returns an empty string if posted, or the reason it could not be. */
function CreditControlPostWriteOff($WriteOffID, $ApprovedBy, $ApprovalNote) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT writeoffs.*,
							currencies.decimalplaces
						FROM writeoffs
						INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
							ON writeoffs.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
						INNER JOIN currencies
							ON debtorsmaster.currcode = currencies.currabrev
						WHERE writeoffs.id = '" . (int) $WriteOffID . "'
						AND writeoffs.status = 'pending'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return __('The write-off does not exist or has been dealt with already');
	}
	$WriteOff = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Accounts = CreditControlAccounts();
	$AccountResult = DB_query("SELECT accountcode FROM chartmaster WHERE accountcode = '" . $Accounts['baddebtact'] . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($AccountResult) == 0) {
		return __('The bad debt general ledger account has not been set up in the credit control settings');
	}

	$DocsResult = DB_query("SELECT id, balance, rate
							FROM debtortrans
							WHERE debtorno = '" . $WriteOff['debtorno'] . "'
							AND type IN (10, 15)
							AND balance > 0.005
							ORDER BY trandate, id");
	$Remaining = round($WriteOff['amount'], $WriteOff['decimalplaces']);
	$Allocations = array();
	$Local = 0;
	while ($Doc = DB_fetch_array($DocsResult)) {
		if ($Remaining < 0.005 OR $Doc['rate'] == 0) {
			continue;
		}
		$Take = round(min($Doc['balance'], $Remaining), $WriteOff['decimalplaces']);
		$Allocations[] = array($Doc['id'], $Take);
		$Local += $Take / $Doc['rate'];
		$Remaining -= $Take;
	}
	if ($Remaining > 0.005 OR $Local <= 0) {
		return __('The customer no longer owes as much as the write-off, so it cannot be posted');
	}
	$Local = round($Local, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
	$EffectiveRate = $WriteOff['amount'] / $Local;
	$Today = date('Y-m-d');
	$Narrative = __('Bad debt write-off') . ' ' . $WriteOff['id'] . ': ' . $WriteOff['reason'];

	DB_Txn_Begin();
	$Posted = CreditControlPostDebtorJournal($WriteOff['debtorno'],
											-$WriteOff['amount'],
											$EffectiveRate,
											$Today,
											__('Write-off') . ' ' . $WriteOff['id'],
											$Narrative,
											array(array('account' => $Accounts['baddebtact'], 'amount' => $Local),
												array('account' => $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], 'amount' => -$Local)));
	foreach ($Allocations as $Allocation) {
		CreditControlAllocate($Posted['id'], $Allocation[0], $Allocation[1], $Today);
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE writeoffs
				SET status = 'posted',
					homeamount = '" . $Local . "',
					approvedby = '" . $ApprovedBy . "',
					approveddate = NOW(),
					approvalnote = '" . mb_substr($ApprovalNote, 0, 200) . "',
					debtortransid = '" . $Posted['id'] . "',
					transno = '" . $Posted['transno'] . "'
				WHERE id = '" . $WriteOff['id'] . "'",
			__('The write-off could not be marked as posted because'), '', true);
	CreditControlLog($WriteOff['debtorno'], 'WRITEOFF', $Narrative . ' (' . __('journal') . ' ' . $Posted['transno'] . ')', $WriteOff['amount'], $WriteOff['currcode']);
	EnsureGLEntriesBalance(15, $Posted['transno']);
	DB_Txn_Commit();

	if ($WriteOff['stopcustomer'] == 1) {
		$Status = GetCreditStatus($WriteOff['debtorno']);
		if ($Status !== false AND $Status['status'] != 'stop') {
			$StopResult = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices = 1 ORDER BY reasoncode LIMIT 1");
			if (DB_num_rows($StopResult) > 0) {
				$StopRow = DB_fetch_row($StopResult);
				CreditControlSetStatus($WriteOff['debtorno'], $StopRow[0], __('Automatically put on stop because a debt was written off'));
			}
		}
	}
	return '';
}

/* Put a customer on stop or on watch, or back to normal, by pointing it at a hold reason of that kind. The change and who made it
 go into the credit history. Returns false if the reason code does not exist. */
function CreditControlSetStatus($DebtorNo, $ReasonCode, $Note) {
	$Old = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	$ReasonResult = DB_query("SELECT reasondescription, dissallowinvoices FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode = '" . (int) $ReasonCode . "'");
	if ($Old === false OR DB_num_rows($ReasonResult) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Reason = DB_fetch_array($ReasonResult);
	if ($Reason['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		$NewStatus = 'stop';
	} elseif ($Reason['dissallowinvoices'] == 2) {
		$NewStatus = 'watch';
	} else {
		$NewStatus = 'normal';
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason = '" . (int) $ReasonCode . "' WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status of the customer could not be changed because'));
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo,
					strtoupper($NewStatus),
					CreditStatusText($Old['status']) . ' (' . DB_escape_string($Old['reasondescription']) . ') ' . __('to') . ' ' . CreditStatusText($NewStatus) . ' (' . DB_escape_string($Reason['reasondescription']) . '): ' . $Note);
	return true;
}

 gltrans entries in home currency. Returns the new debtortrans id, number and period. */
function CreditControlPostDebtorJournal($DebtorNo, $AmountFX, $Rate, $TransDateSQL, $Reference, $Narrative, $GLLines) {
	$BranchResult = DB_query("SELECT custbranch.branchcode,
									custbranch.salesman,
									debtorsmaster.salestype
							FROM custbranch
							INNER JOIN debtorsmaster

 invoices and charges, the way a receipt would be. Each invoice is cleared at its own exchange rate, so the debtors control account is credited with
 exactly what those invoices put in it, and the whole carrying value, exchange difference included, goes to the bad debt account.
 Returns an empty string if posted, or the reason it could not be. */
function CreditControlPostWriteOff($WriteOffID, $ApprovedBy, $ApprovalNote) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT writeoffs.*,
							currencies.decimalplaces
						FROM writeoffs
						INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
							ON writeoffs.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
						INNER JOIN currencies
							ON debtorsmaster.currcode = currencies.currabrev
						WHERE writeoffs.id = '" . (int) $WriteOffID . "'
						AND writeoffs.status = 'pending'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return __('The write-off does not exist or has been dealt with already');
	}
	$WriteOff = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Accounts = CreditControlAccounts();
	$AccountResult = DB_query("SELECT accountcode FROM chartmaster WHERE accountcode = '" . $Accounts['baddebtact'] . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($AccountResult) == 0) {
		return __('The bad debt general ledger account has not been set up in the credit control settings');
	}

	$DocsResult = DB_query("SELECT id, balance, rate
							FROM debtortrans
							WHERE debtorno = '" . $WriteOff['debtorno'] . "'
							AND type IN (10, 15)
							AND balance > 0.005
							ORDER BY trandate, id");
	$Remaining = round($WriteOff['amount'], $WriteOff['decimalplaces']);
	$Allocations = array();
	$Local = 0;
	while ($Doc = DB_fetch_array($DocsResult)) {
		if ($Remaining < 0.005 OR $Doc['rate'] == 0) {
			continue;
		}
		$Take = round(min($Doc['balance'], $Remaining), $WriteOff['decimalplaces']);
		$Allocations[] = array($Doc['id'], $Take);
		$Local += $Take / $Doc['rate'];
		$Remaining -= $Take;
	}
	if ($Remaining > 0.005 OR $Local <= 0) {
		return __('The customer no longer owes as much as the write-off, so it cannot be posted');
	}
	$Local = round($Local, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
	$EffectiveRate = $WriteOff['amount'] / $Local;
	$Today = date('Y-m-d');
	$Narrative = __('Bad debt write-off') . ' ' . $WriteOff['id'] . ': ' . DB_escape_string($WriteOff['reason']);

	DB_Txn_Begin();
	$Posted = CreditControlPostDebtorJournal($WriteOff['debtorno'],
											-$WriteOff['amount'],
											$EffectiveRate,
											$Today,
											__('Write-off') . ' ' . $WriteOff['id'],
											$Narrative,
											array(array('account' => $Accounts['baddebtact'], 'amount' => $Local),
												array('account' => $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], 'amount' => -$Local)));
	foreach ($Allocations as $Allocation) {
		CreditControlAllocate($Posted['id'], $Allocation[0], $Allocation[1], $Today);
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE writeoffs
				SET status = 'posted',
					homeamount = '" . $Local . "',
					approvedby = '" . $ApprovedBy . "',
					approveddate = NOW(),
					approvalnote = '" . mb_substr($ApprovalNote, 0, 200) . "',
					debtortransid = '" . $Posted['id'] . "',
					transno = '" . $Posted['transno'] . "'
				WHERE id = '" . $WriteOff['id'] . "'",
			__('The write-off could not be marked as posted because'), '', true);
	CreditControlLog($WriteOff['debtorno'], 'WRITEOFF', $Narrative . ' (' . __('journal') . ' ' . $Posted['transno'] . ')', $WriteOff['amount'], $WriteOff['currcode']);
	EnsureGLEntriesBalance(15, $Posted['transno']);
	DB_Txn_Commit();

	if ($WriteOff['stopcustomer'] == 1) {
		$Status = GetCreditStatus($WriteOff['debtorno']);
		if ($Status !== false AND $Status['status'] != 'stop') {
			$StopResult = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices = 1 ORDER BY reasoncode LIMIT 1");
			if (DB_num_rows($StopResult) > 0) {
				$StopRow = DB_fetch_row($StopResult);
				CreditControlSetStatus($WriteOff['debtorno'], $StopRow[0], __('Automatically put on stop because a debt was written off'));
			}
		}
	}
	return '';
}

function CreditControlSetStatus($DebtorNo, $ReasonCode, $Note) {
	$Old = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	$ReasonResult = DB_query("SELECT reasondescription, dissallowinvoices FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode = '" . (int) $ReasonCode . "'");
	if ($Old === false OR DB_num_rows($ReasonResult) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Reason = DB_fetch_array($ReasonResult);
	if ($Reason['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		$NewStatus = 'stop';
	} elseif ($Reason['dissallowinvoices'] == 2) {
		$NewStatus = 'watch';
	} else {
		$NewStatus = 'normal';
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason = '" . (int) $ReasonCode . "' WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status of the customer could not be changed because'));
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo,
					strtoupper($NewStatus),
					CreditStatusText($Old['status']) . ' (' . DB_escape_string($Old['reasondescription']) . ') ' . __('to') . ' ' . CreditStatusText($NewStatus) . ' (' . DB_escape_string($Reason['reasondescription']) . '): ' . $Note);
	return true;
}

/* Post an approved (or small enough not to need approval) bad debt write-off request.
 The write-off is a customer journal (type 15) that credits the customer's account in the customer's currency and is allocated to the oldest open
 invoices and charges, the way a receipt would be. Each invoice is cleared at its own exchange rate, so the debtors control account is credited with
 exactly what those invoices put in it, and the whole carrying value, exchange difference included, goes to the bad debt account.
 Returns an empty string if posted, or the reason it could not be. */
function CreditControlPostWriteOff($WriteOffID, $ApprovedBy, $ApprovalNote) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT writeoffs.*,
							currencies.decimalplaces
						FROM writeoffs
						INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
							ON writeoffs.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
						INNER JOIN currencies
							ON debtorsmaster.currcode = currencies.currabrev
						WHERE writeoffs.id = '" . (int) $WriteOffID . "'
						AND writeoffs.status = 'pending'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return __('The write-off does not exist or has been dealt with already');
	}
	$WriteOff = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Accounts = CreditControlAccounts();
	$AccountResult = DB_query("SELECT accountcode FROM chartmaster WHERE accountcode = '" . $Accounts['baddebtact'] . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($AccountResult) == 0) {
		return __('The bad debt general ledger account has not been set up in the credit control settings');
	}

	$DocsResult = DB_query("SELECT id, balance, rate
							FROM debtortrans
							WHERE debtorno = '" . $WriteOff['debtorno'] . "'
							AND type IN (10, 15)
							AND balance > 0.005
							ORDER BY trandate, id");
	$Remaining = round($WriteOff['amount'], $WriteOff['decimalplaces']);
	$Allocations = array();
	$Local = 0;
	while ($Doc = DB_fetch_array($DocsResult)) {
		if ($Remaining < 0.005 OR $Doc['rate'] == 0) {
			continue;
		}
		$Take = round(min($Doc['balance'], $Remaining), $WriteOff['decimalplaces']);
		$Allocations[] = array($Doc['id'], $Take);
		$Local += $Take / $Doc['rate'];
		$Remaining -= $Take;
	}
	if ($Remaining > 0.005 OR $Local <= 0) {
		return __('The customer no longer owes as much as the write-off, so it cannot be posted');
	}
	$Local = round($Local, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
	$EffectiveRate = $WriteOff['amount'] / $Local;
	$Today = date('Y-m-d');
	$Narrative = __('Bad debt write-off') . ' ' . $WriteOff['id'] . ': ' . DB_escape_string($WriteOff['reason']);

	DB_Txn_Begin();
	$Posted = CreditControlPostDebtorJournal($WriteOff['debtorno'],
											-$WriteOff['amount'],
											$EffectiveRate,
											$Today,
											__('Write-off') . ' ' . $WriteOff['id'],
											$Narrative,
											array(array('account' => $Accounts['baddebtact'], 'amount' => $Local),
												array('account' => $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], 'amount' => -$Local)));
	foreach ($Allocations as $Allocation) {
		CreditControlAllocate($Posted['id'], $Allocation[0], $Allocation[1], $Today);
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE writeoffs
				SET status = 'posted',
					homeamount = '" . $Local . "',
					approvedby = '" . $ApprovedBy . "',
					approveddate = NOW(),
					approvalnote = '" . rtrim(mb_substr($ApprovalNote, 0, 190), '\\') . "',
					debtortransid = '" . $Posted['id'] . "',
					transno = '" . $Posted['transno'] . "'
				WHERE id = '" . $WriteOff['id'] . "'",
			__('The write-off could not be marked as posted because'), '', true);
	CreditControlLog($WriteOff['debtorno'], 'WRITEOFF', $Narrative . ' (' . __('journal') . ' ' . $Posted['transno'] . ')', $WriteOff['amount'], $WriteOff['currcode']);
	EnsureGLEntriesBalance(15, $Posted['transno']);
	DB_Txn_Commit();

	if ($WriteOff['stopcustomer'] == 1) {
		$Status = GetCreditStatus($WriteOff['debtorno']);
		if ($Status !== false AND $Status['status'] != 'stop') {
			$StopResult = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices = 1 ORDER BY reasoncode LIMIT 1");
			if (DB_num_rows($StopResult) > 0) {
				$StopRow = DB_fetch_row($StopResult);
				CreditControlSetStatus($WriteOff['debtorno'], $StopRow[0], __('Automatically put on stop because a debt was written off'));
			}
		}
	}
	return '';
}

/* Put a customer on stop or on watch, or back to normal, by pointing it at a hold reason of that kind. The change and who made it
 go into the credit history. Returns false if the reason code does not exist. */
function CreditControlSetStatus($DebtorNo, $ReasonCode, $Note) {
	$Old = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	$ReasonResult = DB_query("SELECT reasondescription, dissallowinvoices FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode = '" . (int) $ReasonCode . "'");
	if ($Old === false OR DB_num_rows($ReasonResult) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Reason = DB_fetch_array($ReasonResult);
	if ($Reason['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		$NewStatus = 'stop';
	} elseif ($Reason['dissallowinvoices'] == 2) {
		$NewStatus = 'watch';
	} else {
		$NewStatus = 'normal';
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason = '" . (int) $ReasonCode . "' WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status of the customer could not be changed because'));
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo,
					strtoupper($NewStatus),
					CreditStatusText($Old['status']) . ' (' . DB_escape_string($Old['reasondescription']) . ') ' . __('to') . ' ' . CreditStatusText($NewStatus) . ' (' . DB_escape_string($Reason['reasondescription']) . '): ' . $Note);
	return true;
}

<?php

/* Shared helpers for the credit control pages (CreditControl*.php) and for the order entry routes that have to
 respect a customer's credit status.

 A customer's credit status is NOT a new field. It is the existing debtorsmaster.holdreason, whose
 holdreasons.dissallowinvoices value says what the reason means:
	1 = the account is on stop (no orders, no dispatch, no invoicing)
	2 = the account is on watch (supplied, but everyone dealing with it is warned)
	anything else = normal
 Every route that takes or releases an order asks this file, so there is one rule for all of them. */

/* The pages and functions below look at the page security tokens through the scripts registered for them, in the
 same way SelectOrderItems.php looks at ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php */
function CreditControlUser() {
	return isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControl.php'])
		AND in_array($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControl.php'], $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

function CreditControlApprover() {
	return isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlApprovals.php'])
		AND in_array($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlApprovals.php'], $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* config values are loaded into $_SESSION by GetConfig.php. A database that has not yet run update 44 has none of them, so there is always a default */
function CreditControlParam($Name, $Default) {
	return isset($_SESSION[$Name]) ? $_SESSION[$Name] : $Default;
}

/* The GL accounts credit control posts to are kept in the companies table (not config) so that Z_ChangeGLAccountCode.php renames them with all the others */
function CreditControlAccounts() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT latechargeinterestact,
								latechargefeeact,
								baddebtact
						FROM companies
						WHERE coycode = 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
		return DB_fetch_array($Result);
	}
	return array('latechargeinterestact' => '0', 'latechargefeeact' => '0', 'baddebtact' => '0');
}

/* Returns the credit status of a customer, or false if there is no such customer.
 status is one of 'normal', 'watch' or 'stop' */
function GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
					debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					debtorsmaster.nextcreditreview,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
			FROM debtorsmaster
			INNER JOIN holdreasons
				ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
			WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The credit status of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'stop';
	} elseif ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 2) {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'watch';
	} else {
		$MyRow['status'] = 'normal';
	}
	return $MyRow;
}

function CreditStatusText($Status) {
	switch ($Status) {
		case 'stop':
			return __('On stop');
		case 'watch':
			return __('On watch');
		default:
			return __('Normal');
	}
}

/* A short coloured status for the pages where staff look at a customer. $ShowReason is false for the customer portal */
function CreditStatusBanner($DebtorNo, $ShowReason = true) {
	$Status = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Status === false OR $Status['status'] == 'normal') {
		return '';
	}
	$Reason = ($ShowReason AND $Status['reasondescription'] != '') ? ' - ' . htmlspecialchars($Status['reasondescription'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') : '';
	if ($Status['status'] == 'stop') {
		return prnMsg(__('Credit status') . ': ' . CreditStatusText('stop') . $Reason . '. ' . __('No orders can be taken or goods dispatched. Please contact credit control.'), 'error', '', true);
	}
	return prnMsg(__('Credit status') . ': ' . CreditStatusText('watch') . $Reason . '. ' . __('This customer can still be supplied, but please contact credit control to discuss before taking an order.'), 'warn', '', true);
}

/* reasons a credit controller can choose for a status change. $Kind is 'stop', 'watch' or 'normal' */
function CreditReasonOptions($Kind, $Selected = '') {
	switch ($Kind) {
		case 'stop':
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices = 1';
			break;
		case 'watch':
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices = 2';
			break;
		default:
			$Where = 'dissallowinvoices NOT IN (1, 2)';
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode, reasondescription FROM holdreasons WHERE " . $Where . " ORDER BY reasoncode");
	$Options = '';
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Options .= '<option ' . ($Selected == $MyRow['reasoncode'] ? 'selected="selected" ' : '') . 'value="' . $MyRow['reasoncode'] . '">' . htmlspecialchars($MyRow['reasondescription'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '</option>';
	}
	return $Options;
}

/* the hold reason a new customer starts with: the lowest reason code that is neither stop nor watch */
function CreditDefaultReason() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices NOT IN (1, 2) ORDER BY reasoncode LIMIT 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return 0;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

/* the date of the next credit review for a customer whose account is opened (or loaded) today */
function CreditNextReviewDate() {
	$Months = (int) CreditControlParam('CreditReviewMonths', 12);
	if ($Months < 1) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . $Months . ' months'));
}

/* Would an order of this value (in the customer's currency) take the customer over their credit limit?
 Uses the existing CheckCreditLimits setting (0 = off), and the setting that turns holding on or off. */
function CreditControlOverLimit($DebtorNo, $OrderValue) {
	if (CreditControlParam('CheckCreditLimits', 0) == 0 OR CreditControlParam('CreditHoldOverLimitOrders', 1) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	if (!function_exists('GetCreditAvailable')) {
		include_once(__DIR__ . '/SQL_CommonFunctions.php');
	}
	return (GetCreditAvailable($DebtorNo) - $OrderValue) < 0;
}

/* One line in the history credit control keeps per customer. The auditors read this.
 As elsewhere in webERP, values that came from $_POST or $_GET were escaped by session.php already; text built from the database
 has to be escaped by the caller with DB_escape_string before it is passed in. */
function CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, $Action, $Detail, $Amount = 0, $Currency = '') {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditlog (debtorno,
									logdate,
									userid,
									action,
									detail,
									amount,
									currcode)
			VALUES ('" . $DebtorNo . "',
					NOW(),
					'" . $_SESSION['UserID'] . "',
					'" . $Action . "',
					'" . $Detail . "',
					'" . $Amount . "',
					'" . $Currency . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history entry could not be saved because'));
}

/* The customer's overdue debit documents (invoices, and the interest and fee charges), oldest first.
 The due date follows the customer's payment terms in the same way AgedDebtors.php ages them. */
function CreditOverdueDocuments($DebtorNo) {
	$DueDate = "IF(paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0,
					DATE_ADD(debtortrans.trandate, INTERVAL paymentterms.daysbeforedue DAY),
					DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), INTERVAL paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth DAY))";
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					debtortrans.balance,
					debtortrans.disputed,
					debtortrans.rate,
					" . $DueDate . " AS duedate,
					DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, " . $DueDate . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
			AND debtortrans.type IN (10, 15)
			AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
			HAVING daysoverdue > 0
			ORDER BY duedate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue transactions of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	$Documents = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Documents[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Documents;
}

/* overdue is what is chased and charged: undisputed and net of credits that are on the account but not allocated.
 disputed invoices are listed separately and are neither chased nor charged until the dispute is settled (BR-18) */
function CreditOverdueSummary($DebtorNo) {
	$Summary = array('documents' => CreditOverdueDocuments($DebtorNo),
					'overdue' => 0,
					'disputed' => 0,
					'maxdays' => 0,
					'credits' => 0,
					'net' => 0);
	foreach ($Summary['documents'] as $Document) {
		if ($Document['disputed'] == 1) {
			$Summary['disputed'] += $Document['balance'];
		} else {
			$Summary['overdue'] += $Document['balance'];
			if ($Document['daysoverdue'] > $Summary['maxdays']) {
				$Summary['maxdays'] = $Document['daysoverdue'];
			}
		}
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) AS credits
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
						AND balance < -0.005");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Summary['credits'] = -$MyRow['credits'];
	$Summary['net'] = max(0, $Summary['overdue'] - $Summary['credits']);
	return $Summary;
}

/* Allocate an amount of a credit document (a waiver or a write-off) to a debit document, the way CustomerAllocations.php does:
 a custallocns row, and alloc and settled on both transactions. The credit's alloc has the same sign as its amount. */
function CreditControlAllocate($FromID, $ToID, $Amount, $DateSQL) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (amt,
										datealloc,
										transid_allocfrom,
										transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . $Amount . "',
						'" . $DateSQL . "',
						'" . $FromID . "',
						'" . $ToID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be saved because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . $Amount . " WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'",
			__('The allocation could not be applied to the debit because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'");
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . $Amount . " WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'",
			__('The allocation could not be applied to the credit because'));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < 0.005, 1, 0) WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'");
}

/* Post a customer journal (debtortrans type 15 'Journal - Debtors') with its general ledger entries. Used for interest and fee
 charges (positive), and for waivers and write-offs (negative). The caller owns the transaction (DB_Txn_Begin / DB_Txn_Commit).
 $AmountFX is in the customer's currency; $Rate is the customer's currency rate to the home currency; $GLLines are the
 gltrans entries in home currency. Returns the new debtortrans id, number and period. */
function CreditControlPostDebtorJournal($DebtorNo, $AmountFX, $Rate, $TransDateSQL, $Reference, $Narrative, $GLLines) {
	$BranchResult = DB_query("SELECT custbranch.branchcode,
									custbranch.salesman,
									debtorsmaster.salestype
							FROM custbranch
							INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
								ON custbranch.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
							WHERE custbranch.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
							ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode
							LIMIT 1",
							__('The branch of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	$Branch = DB_fetch_array($BranchResult);

	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(ConvertSQLDate($TransDateSQL));
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo(15);

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									shipvia,
									edisent,
									salesperson)
			VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
					15,
					'" . $DebtorNo . "',
					'" . $Branch['branchcode'] . "',
					'" . $TransDateSQL . "',
					'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
					'" . $PeriodNo . "',
					'" . $Reference . "',
					'" . $Branch['salestype'] . "',
					'" . $Rate . "',
					'" . $AmountFX . "',
					'" . $Narrative . "',
					0,
					1,
					'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The customer journal could not be posted because'), '', true);
	$TransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		foreach ($GLLines as $GLLine) {
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount)
					VALUES (15,
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $TransDateSQL . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $GLLine['account'] . "',
							'" . rtrim(mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 190), '\\') . "',
							'" . $GLLine['amount'] . "')";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The general ledger entry for the customer journal could not be posted because'), '', true);
		}
	}
	return array('id' => $TransID, 'transno' => $TransNo, 'period' => $PeriodNo);
}

/* Post an approved (or small enough not to need approval) bad debt write-off request.
 The write-off is a customer journal (type 15) that credits the customer's account in the customer's currency and is allocated to the oldest open
 invoices and charges, the way a receipt would be. Each invoice is cleared at its own exchange rate, so the debtors control account is credited with
 exactly what those invoices put in it, and the whole carrying value, exchange difference included, goes to the bad debt account.
 Returns an empty string if posted, or the reason it could not be. */
function CreditControlPostWriteOff($WriteOffID, $ApprovedBy, $ApprovalNote) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT writeoffs.*,
							currencies.decimalplaces
						FROM writeoffs
						INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
							ON writeoffs.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
						INNER JOIN currencies
							ON debtorsmaster.currcode = currencies.currabrev
						WHERE writeoffs.id = '" . (int) $WriteOffID . "'
						AND writeoffs.status = 'pending'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return __('The write-off does not exist or has been dealt with already');
	}
	$WriteOff = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Accounts = CreditControlAccounts();
	$AccountResult = DB_query("SELECT accountcode FROM chartmaster WHERE accountcode = '" . $Accounts['baddebtact'] . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($AccountResult) == 0) {
		return __('The bad debt general ledger account has not been set up in the credit control settings');
	}

	$DocsResult = DB_query("SELECT id, balance, rate
							FROM debtortrans
							WHERE debtorno = '" . $WriteOff['debtorno'] . "'
							AND type IN (10, 15)
							AND balance > 0.005
							ORDER BY trandate, id");
	$Remaining = round($WriteOff['amount'], $WriteOff['decimalplaces']);
	$Allocations = array();
	$Local = 0;
	while ($Doc = DB_fetch_array($DocsResult)) {
		if ($Remaining < 0.005 OR $Doc['rate'] == 0) {
			continue;
		}
		$Take = round(min($Doc['balance'], $Remaining), $WriteOff['decimalplaces']);
		$Allocations[] = array($Doc['id'], $Take);
		$Local += $Take / $Doc['rate'];
		$Remaining -= $Take;
	}
	if ($Remaining > 0.005 OR $Local <= 0) {
		return __('The customer no longer owes as much as the write-off, so it cannot be posted');
	}
	$Local = round($Local, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
	$EffectiveRate = $WriteOff['amount'] / $Local;
	$Today = date('Y-m-d');
	$Narrative = __('Bad debt write-off') . ' ' . $WriteOff['id'] . ': ' . DB_escape_string($WriteOff['reason']);

	DB_Txn_Begin();
	$Posted = CreditControlPostDebtorJournal($WriteOff['debtorno'],
											-$WriteOff['amount'],
											$EffectiveRate,
											$Today,
											__('Write-off') . ' ' . $WriteOff['id'],
											$Narrative,
											array(array('account' => $Accounts['baddebtact'], 'amount' => $Local),
												array('account' => $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], 'amount' => -$Local)));
	foreach ($Allocations as $Allocation) {
		CreditControlAllocate($Posted['id'], $Allocation[0], $Allocation[1], $Today);
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE writeoffs
				SET status = 'posted',
					homeamount = '" . $Local . "',
					approvedby = '" . $ApprovedBy . "',
					approveddate = NOW(),
					approvalnote = '" . rtrim(mb_substr($ApprovalNote, 0, 190), '\\') . "',
					debtortransid = '" . $Posted['id'] . "',
					transno = '" . $Posted['transno'] . "'
				WHERE id = '" . $WriteOff['id'] . "'",
			__('The write-off could not be marked as posted because'), '', true);
	CreditControlLog($WriteOff['debtorno'], 'WRITEOFF', $Narrative . ' (' . __('journal') . ' ' . $Posted['transno'] . ')', $WriteOff['amount'], $WriteOff['currcode']);
	EnsureGLEntriesBalance(15, $Posted['transno']);
	DB_Txn_Commit();

	if ($WriteOff['stopcustomer'] == 1) {
		$Status = GetCreditStatus($WriteOff['debtorno']);
		if ($Status !== false AND $Status['status'] != 'stop') {
			$StopResult = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices = 1 ORDER BY reasoncode LIMIT 1");
			if (DB_num_rows($StopResult) > 0) {
				$StopRow = DB_fetch_row($StopResult);
				CreditControlSetStatus($WriteOff['debtorno'], $StopRow[0], __('Automatically put on stop because a debt was written off'));
			}
		}
	}
	return '';
}

/* Put a customer on stop or on watch, or back to normal, by pointing it at a hold reason of that kind. The change and who made it
 go into the credit history. Returns false if the reason code does not exist. */
function CreditControlSetStatus($DebtorNo, $ReasonCode, $Note) {
	$Old = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	$ReasonResult = DB_query("SELECT reasondescription, dissallowinvoices FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode = '" . (int) $ReasonCode . "'");
	if ($Old === false OR DB_num_rows($ReasonResult) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Reason = DB_fetch_array($ReasonResult);
	if ($Reason['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		$NewStatus = 'stop';
	} elseif ($Reason['dissallowinvoices'] == 2) {
		$NewStatus = 'watch';
	} else {
		$NewStatus = 'normal';
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason = '" . (int) $ReasonCode . "' WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status of the customer could not be changed because'));
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo,
					strtoupper($NewStatus),
					CreditStatusText($Old['status']) . ' (' . DB_escape_string($Old['reasondescription']) . ') ' . __('to') . ' ' . CreditStatusText($NewStatus) . ' (' . DB_escape_string($Reason['reasondescription']) . '): ' . $Note);
	return true;
}
